Chapter 100: 100 - Magic Evolution!

[NunuNote: We’ve reached Chapter 100! I’m very happy to have achieved this, especially after so many people doubted I would get this far LOL! Thank you for being part of this journey with me!]

"I think I found it!" Lohan said excitedly as he digested the brain of one of the beetles.

Although he didn’t receive any new evolution from these latest creatures, Lohan was digesting hundreds of biomass per hour while they rested.

Unlike the low-level monsters he digested days ago, these Level 10 Beetles were highly dense in biomass.

If Lohan had time to completely digest their bodies, each Beetle would yield him between 300 to 400 Biomass.

That was around 4,000 Biomass available to him!

Unfortunately, to digest this at his normal speed, he would still need 15 hours, and even with [Hemolymphatic Tissue] active, it would still take him 5 hours to digest it all.

Sure, after finishing the Dungeon raid, it wouldn’t be too late to go back and finish digesting these beetles.

For now, Lohan focused only on digesting the most important parts, such as the head with the brain of each creature.

And while digesting that brain, he read an interesting memory!

-xXx-

In that memory, the world was a strange mixture of refracted lights and rhythmic vibrations felt through the strange jointed legs.

The insect flew through the tunnels of the third floor, where the air was denser and laden with a sweet smell of Mana.

There, the internal architecture of the tree changed slightly... the wooden walls were not only curved, but supported dozens of cocoons hanging like macabre fruits. Inside some, the beetle saw small figures of creatures whose wings were withered, and in other niches, pulsating eggs awaited the vital essence to be drained from the prisoners so they could hatch.

The beetle’s flight was steady, driven by a simple instinct to patrol without any critical or individual thought, until the air seemed to freeze.

Suddenly, a powerful and overwhelming consciousness invaded his mind!

It was not a cry, but an absolute command that crushed the insect’s already low individuality in a millisecond. His body no longer belonged to him, his wings flapped with artificial force, driven by the power of a higher source.

"TO THE SECOND FLOOR. AMBUSH. KILL."

He felt his mind being connected to a network.

Through this connection, he realized he was not alone; dozens of other beetles, coming from deep crevices and from the floors above, were being artificially moved like lifeless puppets.

Consciousness controlled his every movement, forcing him to position himself in absolute silence on the second floor, keeping a safe distance so that the invaders would not notice the trap.

When the Slime and the Fox crossed the hole in the ceiling, the mental voice gave the signal.

The beetle dove under the direct command of that will. He saw the commands appearing as flashes of light in his mind: "Flank the fox on the left! Bite the slime’s black shell now!" He fought with a coordination he would never have had on his own, moving in perfect sync with his hive brothers to overwhelm the defenses of the pair of intruders.

At first, the beetle was satisfied to be carrying out the mental orders he received, but when his brothers began to die and he realized that he might not survive the attack of these monsters that had invaded his nest, the consciousness that controlled him also began to tremble.

When the last group of beetles was wiped out, a wave of pure, destructive mental rage hit his mind, coming from the top of the tree.

The control disappeared as quickly as it had arrived, leaving the beetle stunned and vulnerable.

The last thing the creature felt before total darkness was the frustrated fury of his Queen and the pain of the Slime digesting his still-living body...

-xXx-

Through the beetle’s memories, Lohan was able to better understand the structure of the tree and find the place where the eggs of captured creatures were kept, as well as the location of the Queen!

"Lisa, I have good news," Lohan said with relief.

Hearing this, the still-wounded fox looked at him with hopeful eyes, totally different from the unshakeable confidence she had when entering this dungeon.

With so many accumulated injuries, Lisa was already wondering if they would really be able to complete this dungeon.

Lohan could recover from his injuries, but for her, with each battle, the accumulated injuries and the pain she felt increased...

"What is it?" She asked.

Confirming the information again through the beetle’s memories, only then was Lohan sure. "I found the locations of the creatures captured by the beetles! They are scattered across the upper floors at specific strategic points in the tree, guarded by other beetles, but although the remaining beetles are even more powerful than the ones we’ve faced so far, their numbers are much smaller than those of ordinary beetles."

"The Queen values the cocoons of the captured creatures very highly, so she leaves one or two of these beetles to guard these areas separately!"

Lohan didn’t need to explain to her why this was good news.

Honestly, in this battle, their biggest disadvantage was not that they were weaker than the beetles individually. In fact, with their synergy, their strength was much greater than that of ordinary Level 10 monsters, even though they were still at Level 8, but it was impossible to deal with the numerical disadvantage...

Facing more than ten enemies at the same time was very physically and mentally exhausting, so knowing that they would have to face fewer enemies, even if they were stronger, was not bad news!

Knowing that there were few beetles left on the tree, the two allowed themselves to rest even more.

To maximize the speed of digestion, Lohan even asked Lisa to hit him with a weaker attack to activate the [Hemolymphatic Tissue] since he couldn’t activate it on himself.

With a speed of 780 Biomass per hour, in 1 hour and 17 minutes Lohan accumulated 1,000 Biomass!

Of that 1,000 Biomass, 700 Biomass had to be used to heal him and stored to be used as a reserve in battle, but the remaining 300 Biomass was quickly converted into evolutions!

The first 100.77 Biomass of that was spent on one of the most useful evolutions for him at that moment!

[Hemolymphatic Tissue Lv 10 → Lv 11]

[After 10 minor evolutions, Hemolymphatic Tissue is undergoing a qualitative evolution...] 𝑓𝘳𝑒𝑒𝓌𝘦𝘣𝘯ℴ𝑣𝘦𝑙.𝘤𝑜𝑚

[New trait obtained: Bio-Synthetic Mana Circulation!]

[Bio-Synthetic Mana Circulation: The hemolymphatic system becomes capable of channeling byproducts of accelerated molecular breakdown directly to the core. During the processing of biomass under combat stress, a percentage of the converted matter is refined into pure mana, replenishing the user’s reservoir proportionally to the digestion rate.]

Reading this description made Lohan’s eyes light up!

’Now I can recover Mana while using my digestion in battle! With this, I’ll be able to use my spells with much more intensity!’

This was great news for him!

Before, he depended solely on the standard, slow rate of mana recovery he had, but with this new feature, just as his biomass was almost "infinite" during combat if he had corpses around to digest, his mana now had that potential too!

With such a big advantage on his magical side, Lohan decided to invest a little more in magic, to try to abuse it to be even more useful in combat, accepting even more this symbiotic and supportive side that he was developing for now.

’When I finish my basic development, when I can digest thousands, or even tens of thousands of biomass per hour, it won’t be too late to focus on my solo combat methods as well!

Seeing that the cost for the next evolution of the Magic Core was only 106.64 Biomass, he didn’t hesitate and bought it too!

[Magic Core Lv 10 → Lv 11]

[After 10 minor evolutions, Magic Core is undergoing a qualitative evolution...]

[New feature obtained: Parallel Processing Core!]

[Parallel Processing Core: The vital core expands its internal architecture to support the opening of multiple independent mana paths operating simultaneously.]

Upon reading this new feature, Lohan became even more delighted!

Not because he wanted to fire magic simultaneously like a machine gun, which could also be interesting, but because he saw in it the possibility of making his little clones even more useful!

Before, even if he tried to use magic through the clones, the process was almost impossible, with him having to stop using spells in his main body to allow the clone to also use spells.

His limit was to use [Pigmentation Mimicry] on the clone’s body and his main body simultaneously, and that alone was very exhausting for him.

Now with this new feature, instead of the clones being useful only for setting small traps to capture or digest enemies, the level of strategies he could form would escalate directly!

The clones could serve as small turrets to attack unsuspecting enemies from angles that were impossible to defend against!

Since he was already at it, Lohan gritted his teeth and spent a little of his budget to purchase another evolution in this area.

[Artificial Magic Core Harmonizer Lv 7 → Lv 8]

The cost for this evolution was 144.25 Biomass, but with greater control over his Mana for combat, Lohan felt even more excited to deal with the next enemies!

"Are you ready, Lisa?" Lohan asked.

Lisa looked at him, and without understanding the reason for his sudden excitement, considering the difficulty of the battle they had fought a short time ago, she answered positively, but a little hesitantly.

She didn’t want to show weakness to him; the family training she had undergone would not allow that.

Chapter 101: 101 - Parallel Processing is very OP!

The climb to the third floor was accompanied by the heavy sound of Lisa’s breathing.

Despite the massive victory on the lower floor and the fact that they had plenty of time to rest, her white fur still showed flaws and dried blood stains that could not be ignored.

Crossing the hole in the ceiling, the scenery changed as they followed the path Lohan deduced from the beetle’s memories.

With [Memory Resonance Lv 5], Lohan could already see a little further into the past through the memories of the monsters he digested.

The cost to level up this skill was very low, requiring only 13.25 Biomass, but Lohan was hesitant to evolve it further, considering the traumatic experience of digesting the Weaver Spider’s memory... he decided that he would at least wait until he reached Level 11 to evolve it again.

With his base strength increasing so much, he would be more confident that he would not be controlled again by the memories of the creatures he digested, opening up more possibilities to abuse the advantages of this evolution.

At this point, the air was denser, saturated with the sweet smell of Mana, and the walls displayed broken or open silk cocoons where captured creatures were kept before being completely sucked dry.

Unfortunately, they didn’t find any cocoons with anyone who could be saved.

It didn’t take long for Lohan’s [Spatial Echo-Location] vibrations to pick up the new threat.

As they were approaching the first point where the captured creatures were still kept alive, the noise of four beetles caught their attention.

Three of them were the ordinary Level 10 warriors they already knew, but the fourth was different... It was almost 50% larger, with a shell that not only reflected light but emitted a pulsating metallic glow.

"Lisa, the biggest one must be an Elite... Let me take care of the side coordination, focus on your wounded flank!" Lohan transmitted, already expanding his biomass over her in the form of Living Armor. 𝕗𝗿𝕖𝐞𝐰𝗲𝕓𝐧𝕠𝕧𝗲𝐥.𝚌𝐨𝚖

Lisa attempted a quick charge with [Spectral Step], but a slight tremor in her wounded leg caused her jump to lack its usual precision.

Hearing the noise caused by her movement, two normal beetles dove in that direction without a second thought.

"Now... let’s test what so many evolutions have brought me!" Lohan thought excitedly, activating the [Parallel Processing Core].

Previously, Lohan had to switch focus between his main body and his clones, which caused a dangerous delay, like someone playing an online game with a ping of over 1,000 ms.

With the addition of [Pack Instinct Lv 10], this latency decreased even further, but with the [Parallel Processing Core], this latency was at a level where his control over the clones was at a decent level for combat!

He felt as if his mind had split into independent processing tracks, and he expelled two clones through [Partial Division Lv 7] that fell like blue arrows.

While Lohan’s main body used [Magic Weaving Lv 3] to create a containment net around Lisa, the two clones acted autonomously and simultaneously, firing sequences of [Ice Spikes] at the beetles flanking the fox.

-- SHIIIING! SHIIIING!

The ice projectiles struck the monsters’ wing joints with precision close to that of the main body, guided by [Monocular Telescopic Vision Lv 9].

For the first time, Lohan did not feel the drain of Mana stalling his actions.

Thanks to [Bio-Synthetic Mana Circulation], as his clones began [Efficient Digestion] on the beetles’ struck limbs, Lohan’s Mana reservoir began to recharge in real time during combat, allowing for a much higher firing rate!

’His power... it’s as if there were four Halons fighting at the same time...’ Lisa thought in wonder, though she let out a low yelp when the Elite beetle collided with the [Obsidian Exoskeleton] on her shoulder.

Even though Halon had a Mythic Race, a tier above her Legendary Race, she didn’t feel that the difference between them was that great.

What Halon had in versatility, she made up for with concentrated firepower and speed, being the opposite of Slime.

But as time went by, Halon began to improve each of his skills, making what was once a Jack of All Trades but Master of None, now begin to master those All Trades and slowly walk the path of Master of All!

Sure, even realizing this, she still had confidence in herself. After all, from what she had learned, with each major evolution, Spirit Foxes receive an extra tail and their power increases greatly!

The advantage Halon had accumulated so far might not grow as much as hers with each evolution, but at his rate of growth, she realized she would have to work hard not to be left behind.

Returning to the battle, a beetle had just attacked her side with force.

The impact was violent, but [Non-Newtonian Resilience] instantly hardened Lohan’s membrane, protecting Lisa’s bone from being shattered.

With the [Bio-Synthetic Mana Circulation] feeding the [Artificial Magic Core Harmonizer Lv 7], Lohan no longer needed to conserve Mana.

He fired a sequence of ice spikes from the top of his armor, forcing the Elite to retreat while Lisa prepared for a counterattack with [Spirit Fire].

The difference between the Elite Beetle and the common ones was clear not only in size but also in the way it behaved on the battlefield.

While normal Level 10 beetles attacked with an aggressive but predictable instinct, the Elite waited for openings left by Lisa’s accumulated injuries to deliver much more dangerous and lethal blows.

Lohan realized that the creature’s movements possessed a tactical coordination that he didn’t know if it came from its own sentience or if their Queen was using the insect as a biological puppet from the observatory at the top, as she did with the ambush she formed in the previous combat.

"Lisa, focus on staying stable! I’ll use the clones to clear the way!" Lohan commanded through the mental link.

Taking advantage of the new [Parallel Processing Core], Lohan performed a maneuver that would have been impossible before.

While the main body maintained the Living Armor and [Obsidian Exoskeleton] to protect Lisa, he expelled another clone through [Partial Division Lv 7].

Now with 3 clones, thanks to multiple processing, they were able to act autonomously and instantly, sliding across the ground with [Viscous Flow] to intercept the three common beetles.

While the clones immobilized the scouts with [Selective Viscosity] and began forced digestion, the Mana digestion became even stronger.

Lohan felt an even greater constant flow of pure Mana being refined from the beetles’ biomass and injected directly into his core.

With the reservoir being recharged in real time, he worried even less about Mana consumption in this battle.

Confident, he projected strands of [Magic Weaving Lv 3] from Lisa’s back, creating an adhesive containment net that limited the Elite’s room to maneuver.

The larger beetle tried to retreat, but Lisa, using the threads as pivots, fired off [Spectral Step] to close in, ignoring the pain she felt with each sudden movement.

The Elite, realizing it was isolated, attempted a desperate charge, but Lohan had already set the trap.

He positioned one of his clones while controlling the battle with Lisa, a clone that was reinforced by [Non-Newtonian Resilience] at the exact point of impact, transforming the membrane into a solid barrier that caused the Elite beetle to stall in midair.

Before the monster could recover, Lisa delivered a kick imbued with [Spirit Fire] directly into the crack in the shell opened by Lohan’s [Ice Spike].

The metallic shell, which the Queen had hardened by draining the life essence of other beings, finally shattered.

As the Elite’s life drained away under the digestion of the Slime and the Fox’s flames, an enraged scream, followed by a wave of pure, dissonant mental rage, echoed from the top of the fossilized tree, causing the wooden walls to vibrate in protest.

Feeling that fury, Lohan didn’t even have time to digest all those beetles, using his digestion at full power while making spines with tentacles to penetrate the beetle’s body as quickly as possible and rip out its Mana Core!

Just as he had learned from Edgar in Thalendor, the vendor at the Horizon Bazaar, Lohan was happy to have obtained another Mana Stone, something that would likely give him a new evolution or a useful spell for his development!

Even if it didn’t yield anything useful, even the money he would earn from selling it could be useful.

Considering that this was a Level 10 Monster Mana Stone, its value would perhaps be even greater than their earnings from the Shadow Serpent Digestive Acid or the sale of Swamp Slugs!

The problem was that as they fled, Lohan realized that Lisa was even more injured. Her body, which was already struggling to cope with this battle, showed even more difficulty in continuing to face the insects in this dungeon, causing a thought of doubt to arise in his mind.

’Should we go back and run away? Or should we take more risks to conquer this dungeon today? If we run away, all the captured creatures will probably die to create more beetles...’

Chapter 102: 102 - Retreat!

"Lisa, do you think you can keep going?" Lohan asked worriedly.

If he weren’t so slow, he would have liked to get off her back and not let her carry him, considering that he was adding an even greater burden to an already injured and weakened body.

Lisa, panting, continued running through the pain she felt and replied in a firm voice. "We can’t retreat... According to the information I received, the resources that the Hogue Group brought to the Open World are vast. Since they are willing to spend a lot of money on a medium-sized city, it is very possible that they will be able to found the first guild in Elysium today or tomorrow... and that is something we cannot allow under any circumstances, Halon."

Lohan listened to this explanation and became thoughtful.

Apparently, the reward for founding the first guild must be very valuable, since Lisa is willing to take such a big risk to achieve it... the problem is that if they get into a critical situation, not only would they lose this race, but they would also have a chance of losing their High Rarity characters...

’To what extent is this reward more valuable than a Legendary and Mythical character?’ he wondered.

Sure, he also wanted the reward, and he was reaping many benefits from this dungeon raid without losing much, but Lisa was different. She was dealing with the pain of being injured while fighting the most powerful monsters we had encountered so far...

Her willpower was both admirable and foolish at the same time.

Looking inside himself, Lohan felt the Basic Life Seed and the Elite Beetle’s Mana Stone they had killed, while completely ignoring the digestion of the Mana Stone and focusing on the Life Seed, which at this point was almost completely digested.

He had no idea what he would receive upon completely digesting it, if he would receive anything beyond the large amount of Biomass available in it, but at the point they were reaching, any help would be very welcome, so he asked Lisa to attack it again, keeping the [Hemolymphatic Tissue Lv 11] active, and fully utilizing the new digestion speed of 832 Bio/h that level 11 of this evolution brought, to finish this as quickly as possible.

-- BBBZZZZZZ

Suddenly, the sound of beetles flapping their wings arose again.

Lohan went into combat mode, hugging the fox’s body completely and preparing to activate the [Obsidian Exoskeleton Lv 4] at any moment, while Lisa, exhausted, let out a sigh and ignored the pain in her leg, trying to speed up her movement to avoid this group of beetles.

Unfortunately, although the interior of the tree was very large, it was not large enough for them to easily escape from the beetles. 𝒻𝑟ℯℯ𝑤𝑒𝑏𝑛𝘰𝓋𝑒𝓁.𝒸𝑜𝘮

Within a few minutes of playing hide-and-seek with them, a beetle picked up a peculiar odor in one direction and realized that that part of the tree was very strange.

With his poor eyesight, he couldn’t see anything wrong there, since Lohan had camouflaged them both with the tree’s surroundings, but the smell they gave off was getting stronger and stronger, attracting even more attention from the insect.

Using the mental network that the queen had formed for them, within seconds the sound of more wings flapping arose, indicating that other beetles were also arriving.

This made the two realize that there was no longer any reason to hide, so, taking advantage of the beetle’s poor vision, he shot a line of web at the insect flying in front of them, looking confused at where they should be, and using that as support, Lohan sent a smaller Slime at the unsuspecting insect.

The smaller Slime was also camouflaged with the environment, causing the beetle that tried to break free from the magic web not to notice the small gelatinous sphere approaching.

Without giving the monster time to react, a translucent ice spike formed during flight and was quickly fired, aimed at the beetle’s neck joint to try to sever its head.

Unfortunately, the beetle’s frantic flight to break free from Lohan’s magical web caused the shot to miss its specific target, but luckily for the pair, the ice spike still pierced the beetle’s wing, passing through it with ease and leaving a hollow hole there.

-- SCREEEE!

The beetle screamed in pain or anger as it flapped its wings even more desperately, finally managing to break free from Lohan’s web, but now struggling with the imbalance of flying with a hollow wing.

Having to focus on maintaining stable flight, the beetle didn’t notice until it was too late that Lohan’s little Clone had reached it and stuck to the creature’s lower chest.

Without waiting for anything, Lohan made the clone begin digestion, which, thanks to Lisa’s help, already had [Hemolymphatic Tissue Lv 11] active at full power, corroding the beetle to the naked eye while expelling poison into the insect’s organism.

This double process of corrosion and direct poisoning caused the beetle to fall from the sky in a few seconds, hitting the ground while writhing in a last desperate struggle.

Unfortunately, this beetle was just a common Level 10 monster, so there was no Mana Stone for Lohan to steal.

Soon after recovering the clone inside himself, Lohan didn’t even need to warn Lisa to run, as she had already dashed forward, trying not to be seen by the beetles flying towards them.

As the inside of the tree was dark, Lohan was using [Pigmentation Mimicry] and [Threshold Mimicry] to the fullest to go unnoticed by the insects.

Fortunately, the strong smell of the beetle they had killed was more noticeable than the strange smell emitted by the "nothing" below the beetles, allowing the pair to flee the scene of the crime.

"Huff... Huff... Huff..." Despite not participating directly in the battle, Lisa was even more breathless than before, showing that the injuries were really wearing the fox down more than they appeared.

"Lisa, you definitely need to rest... in your condition, let alone dealing with a group with the Dungeon Boss Queen, if we encounter a group with an Elite Beetle, I don’t even know if you’ll be able to resist!" Lohan said in a firm tone.

Hearing his tone of voice, Lisa felt uncomfortable, unaccustomed to anyone speaking to her like that other than her mother, but she felt that not only was he saying this with good intentions for her, making it clear that he was concerned for her safety, but that he was actually right...

"Okay... let’s try to get out of the tree and rest for a few hours, maybe even go back to Thalendor and try to find some healing potions to treat my injuries..." She said in a lower tone of voice. "But we must return to finish this dungeon today, it cannot be postponed until tomorrow under any circumstances, okay?!"

Lohan agreed with that. "Yes, as long as we can deal with your injury, I have no problem dominating this dungeon today, I’m just concerned about your current situation."

With the agreement signed, Lisa began to move more carefully and slowly, returning the way they had come while delicately avoiding the beetle patrols that constantly flew overhead.

Chapter 103: 103 - Desperate Situation!

Lisa shook her head. "That’s impossible. A guild can only be formed by a group of at least two players. Unless there is another player in contact with that beetle, which I find a little difficult, we are safe."

Concerned about this, Lohan decided to activate all of his tracking Evolutions to try to find this Dungeon Core while still digesting the Queen’s corpse.

[Instinctive Perception Lv 15]

[Chemosensory Aptitude Lv 11]

[Monocular Telescopic Vision Lv 9]

[Thermographic Perception Lv 9]

With these four evolutions activated at the same time, Lohan felt a flood of sensations wash over him.

Using these evolutions separately was no problem, but the more active evolutions he added at the same time, the more apparent the smell of everything in this tree became with his instinctive perception, which also amplified his thermal vision, which at the same time was being boosted by his telescopic vision...

Using these four evolutions together was not a simple 1+1+1+1=4, it was more like 1+1+1+1=8!

And if he could get another evolution in this sense and try to activate it at the same time, the result would probably rise to 1+1+1+1+1=16!

That was the magic of the evolution stack. Even if the levels of the evolutions in general were not spectacular, spending less Biomass to raise the level of several evolutions could bring him an even better result!

And with so much biomass he was absorbing, after filling his biomass reservoir, Lohan intended to spend another 1,000 or 2,000 biomass just evolving the various low-level evolutions he had accumulated!

Sure, some high-level main ones would still be focused on, but he would undergo a major upgrade!

Suddenly, with all these sensations active, Lohan realized that there was nothing unusual on that floor, but inside the Queen’s body that he was digesting, there was a Mana Stone very different from the ones he had seen before.

Considering that the Queen Beetle was a Player, the possibility of her having a Mana Stone inside her was very low.

’It’s hard to say when I’ve only met two Players so far...’ He thought frustratedly, looking at the fox beside him and the giant corpse he was digesting. ’I’ll let Lisa continue searching while I focus on making my way to that stone...’

Lohan thought, and did just that.

Stretching four tentacles forward, Lohan began to digest a path inside the giant corpse like a hot knife through butter.

Instead of focusing on digesting as much as possible, he focused on clearing as much of the way as possible, and it worked.

In a few minutes, he felt the touch of the cold Stone on the tip of his tentacle.

To make sure he didn’t mess up, Lohan activated [Selective Digestion] and focused on digesting only the organic parts of that body and put that strange Mana Stone inside himself.

With the Mana Stone inside him, Lohan could see it in detail, which made the discrepancy between it and ordinary Mana Stones glaring!

"Lisa, I think I found what we’re looking for!" Lohan said excitedly, rolling at high speed along the path he had opened in the Queen’s body.

Hearing Lohan’s words in her mind, Lisa transformed into a White Flash, even using [Spectral Step] to get there even faster, ignoring the stench that body had and looking at the hole opened there with anticipation.

In a few seconds, the blue gelatinous ball appeared there and rolled out, carrying a total of 3 Stones inside it.

One of the stones was the Mana Stone he took from one of the Elite Beetles they eliminated earlier, the other stone was his Slime Core, something all Slimes had, and lastly there was an almost glowing red gem.

That gem seemed charged with an energy totally different from anything they had seen so far.

When the fox’s eyes fell on it, Lisa was sure that Lohan had really found what they were looking for.

Lohan formed a small human hand, which at this point was much more realistic than the first few times he used it, and extended the Dungeon Core to Lisa.

Honestly, anyone would be tempted to keep the Core for themselves, become the leader of the Guild themselves, and receive Elysium’s reward for themselves.

But Lohan was not ungrateful.

Lisa was the one who knew this information, Lisa was the one who found the location of the Dungeon for them, Lisa was the one who carried him to level him up as quickly as possible so they could deal with the Dungeon, and most importantly, the future members of the Guild would largely be people affiliated with Lisa in the real world.

If he wanted to become the guild leader, not only would it not work if Lisa didn’t agree to join his guild, since it took two players to form a guild, but he didn’t even know who to call, since he didn’t know any other players!

Considering that he had already received a reward for making the first PK in the Open World, Lohan felt no remorse for handing over this ’golden opportunity’ to the person who had helped him so much up to this point.

Unlike him, who didn’t know what to do to activate it, as soon as Lisa held the Dungeon Core, the red gem began to glow, completely enveloping the fox’s body, and in a few seconds that light spread and covered the Slime’s body as well.

Chapter 114: 114 - Astralis Requiem

Feeling that light embracing his body, Lohan was shocked to realize that both his body and his consciousness were "standing" on a solid, soft, and comfortable cloud under a grand, starry night sky.

This was a stark contrast to the gray horizon and toxic air of the Lower Zone, where pollution stifled any beauty, or even the slightly better sky of the Upper Zone where his college was located.

The world that once saw him as just a small and useless Slime would soon be depending on his gelatinous shoulders to sustain itself.

Chapter 116: 116 - Ernesto Hogue

A few minutes ago, in a human city smaller than Thalendor but still home to tens of thousands of people, a strange group was moving swiftly.

When he woke up, even though he had slept in an uncomfortable, hard, moldy bed, Lohan felt better than ever!

He walked over to the fridge and consumed a Grade A nutritional solution, feeling the nutrients being distributed throughout his body even faster than they had been digested in previous days, bringing a vitality that seemed to nourish even his mind.

Without wasting a second, he began his exercises on the apartment floor; where he had once struggled to complete a few push-ups, he could now perform hundreds of repetitions with seemingly endless stamina... as if his endurance were replenishing itself with every passing second.

As sweat dripped and his muscles revealed themselves to be proportionate and well-defined, Lohan smiled with satisfaction upon realizing that today’s change, though smaller than the three-level jump from the previous day, was still monstrous compared to when he was still Level 01.

He could finally feel Mana circulating through the internal channels of his body with ease.

Sure, it was still much weaker than his Slime body, even at the lowest levels, but just being able to feel it was an incredible sensation.

Tired from the intense grind they’d had the previous day, both Lohan and Lisa decided they’d take the day off from Elysium.

Neither of them specified what they’d do in the real world, but Lohan intended to go to college.

With the money he could earn in the other world, he didn’t even need to worry about the $500 stipend the college sent him every month. But as a precaution to protect his identity, he decided to keep showing up there to maintain the facade that he was just an ordinary kid from the Lower Zone.

Feeling generous with himself, he took a quick cold shower—a luxury he hadn’t been able to afford often in the past few days, considering that water wasn’t cheap on a planet as exploited as this one—and left the house clean.

After putting on all his protective gear and mask, you couldn’t even tell he was clean, but what bothered him was that even with this protective equipment, the dirt in the air still seeped through and touched his skin.

"I guess I’m dirtier as a human than as a slime... who would’ve thought." He thought with a sigh. ’If only I could digest this dirt on my skin like I do in Elysium...’

As soon as he thought that, he felt a slight vibration on his skin, and within seconds, the dirt that had been stuck to his skin—creating a thick, unpleasant sensation from the friction of his clothes—disappeared!

Unfortunately, here he didn’t have 360-degree vision like in Elysium, so he couldn’t confirm what it was, but his intuition—trained over weeks of using [Efficient Digestion] and [Digestive Filter] all the time—made it clear that this was likely the result of his evolutions!

’Wait, am I unlocking all my Slime skills in the real world?!’ He finally realized, shocked.

At first, he thought that only the more standard abilities, the ones that fit his human body, would work in this world!

With a bold idea in mind, Lohan decided to test a few things.

The first was to focus on a bus flying by hundreds of meters above the ground.

At that distance, a normal human eye would have trouble identifying any details of the passengers on that bus, but when he focused, Lohan felt the same sensation as activating the [Monocular Telescopic Vision]!

Discreetly pulling back a part of his glove, Lohan decided to try using one of the skills he relied on most in combat in the other world.

With a single thought, his skin—which had previously been white and pale due to a lack of vitamins and sunlight—slowly began to form hexagonal plates and turn black!

’My [Obsidian Exoskeleton] has come to the real world too?!’

And then, looking up at the tall buildings, an even bolder idea came to his mind.

Reaching his hand forward, touching the tips of his middle and ring fingers to his palm, Lohan made the iconic hand gesture that Web-Head used to shoot webs, but at the last second he snapped back to reality and quickly put the glove back on.

’Idiot, you’re going back to college to play the part of a normal kid from the Lower Zone—don’t give yourself away before you’ve even resumed your disguise!’ He scolded himself, calming his adrenaline and refusing to get carried away by fantasy.

As a huge Spider-Man fan, he really wanted to shoot a web at one of those buildings and swing up, maybe even hanging onto one of the flying buses and riding to college in the open air, but he knew how stupid that idea was, and how counterproductive it was to his plan of staying discreet.

But while he couldn’t test flashy Evolutions like that, he could test more discreet ones!

For example, all of his tracking and mimicry Evolutions worked perfectly in the real world!

Both the Magic Core he’d already used a few days ago and the new Natural Energy Core also worked perfectly.

The physical transformation Evolutions also worked on the human body, such as Viscous Flow, Body Density, Membrane Reinforcement...

All of these Evolutions worked just like in Elysium, only on a much smaller scale of power, granting him only a fraction of the potency and resilience they possessed in the other world.

’I don’t know what I can do to improve this synchronization rate, but considering that with every level I gain in that world I get stronger here, at least I have a path to follow!’

He just didn’t have the courage to test more flashy skills like Partial Division and Memory Resonance.

But that last skill sparked another curiosity in him.

’If I use Memory Resonance in this world to digest the brain of a person or creature, could I achieve some evolution here as well? And if so, could I bring that evolution to Elysium?!’

That single question filled his mind with ideas, but unfortunately had to be interrupted when he arrived at college.

In this world, that kind of situation only happened among the students from the Upper Zone.

Not only did they pay no attention to the students from the Lower Zone, viewing them as less than human, but even the Lower Zone students themselves didn’t try to make friends, afraid of making a mistake here and offending someone from the Upper Zone.

So the previous Lohan was already used to this.

Suddenly, the classroom door opened and everyone looked up.

But when they saw that it was a boy from the Lower Zone who had arrived, their interest vanished instantly, and the background chatter of the Upper Zone students resumed.

This was the boy with the Rare Base he had observed last time.

The two boys’ eyes met, and they noticed the surprise on each other’s faces for a split second, before the boy looked away and continued walking to his usual spot.

Lohan watched the boy with interest for a few more seconds before looking away as well, not wanting to be rude or attract any unwanted attention.

Lohan saw great potential in this boy, even entertaining the idea of inviting him into his guild like Lisa, considering how rare it was to find someone with a Rare Base among the Players.

Especially considering that he was someone like him, coming from the Lower Zone—that alone was enough to make Lohan feel a sense of goodwill toward him.

After a few minutes, with only two minutes left before class started, the classroom door opened again.

Once again, the room fell silent, only this time the silence lasted longer.

At the classroom door, entering without a care that she had caused the silence, Isabella Vance walked confidently toward an empty seat that she felt looked comfortable.

But on her way there, as she passed in front of a boy’s desk from the Lower Zone, she stopped.

Her small white nose twitched upward for a second, sniffing as if she were trying to recognize a familiar scent, but the sensation was so faint that she couldn’t figure out where she knew it from.

Looking around, she could only see a Lower Zone student with his head down, writing something, seemingly unconcerned by her presence.

’That boy... wasn’t he the one Julian Neal was picking on?’ she wondered, a little surprised.

"Isabella, you’re finally here!" Just as she spoke, Julian Neal stood up from where he was sitting and quickly came over to Isabella, greeting her in a very humble and subservient manner, totally different from how he treated the boy from the Lower Zone right in front of her.

Putting that feeling of familiarity aside, Isabella continued walking and went to sit with the other students from the Upper Zone.

Julian flashed a small smile when he saw her walk away from that annoying worm from the Lower Zone and followed her. "Do you want me to carry your backpack for you?"

Isabella simply ignored that comment and carried her own backpack by herself.

Given the technological advancements humanity had developed, the use of backpacks, in-person studies at institutions like this one, and other ritualistic practices like these were pragmatisms that the Human Federation insisted on maintaining as mandatory so that the mental development of young people would not be derailed.

When she left, Lohan had to control himself so as not to exclaim in surprise at the intensity of the energy she exuded!

If the energy he felt from the other boy in the Lower Zone was a 10, the energy Isabella Vance exuded was fluctuating between 40 and 50!

If his estimates that the boy had a Rare Base were accurate, this only further proved that Isabella’s Base was at least Epic, or even Legendary!

Thinking about Legendary Bases, Lohan remembered the only person he knew with a Base like that—the little white fox who, despite acting most of the time with a cold, indifferent, and proud facade, gradually opened up to him and offered a friendship far more genuine than any he had ever felt in his two lifetimes.

Comparing Lisa to Isabella, despite sensing the similarities between the two, Lohan felt that while Lisa was an ice queen with the cute side of an ordinary girl on the inside when dealing with friends, Isabella seemed to be an ice queen 100% of the time; even when dealing with friends from the Upper Zone, she still maintained that attitude, which left him in doubt.

’While they are very similar, the differences still exist between the two...’ he thought.

Because of this doubt regarding their differing personalities, Lohan kept his head down when she approached.

Unlike the other boy from the Lower Zone who couldn’t do anything to him when stared at, if Isabella Vance felt bothered by the gaze of someone from the Lower Zone like him, she could end his life in the blink of an eye, so for someone who just wanted to keep a low profile, it was best not to take any chances.

What they didn’t realize was that this brief interaction sparked curiosity and doubt in each other in real life as well, unaware that their virtual friendship was so close in the real world.

Lohan stopped, adjusting his protective mask, and among the shadows of crumbling buildings, he saw three burly men dragging a small, frail body into the darkness.

The owner of that body struggled feebly, but the men’s brutal grip prevented any attempt to escape.

Lohan hesitated deeply... his muscles tensed, ready to act, but his rational mind held him back. ’If I interfere and draw more attention than I should, this act of kindness would backfire on me, landing me in even more trouble...’ he thought, worried about the things he was already having to deal with.

Lohan didn’t consider himself a kind and righteous hero. When he was younger in the other world, he dreamed that a hero with superpowers might appear and heal his frail body, but that hero never showed up.

While studying medicine, he dreamed not only of helping himself but of using the knowledge he’d acquired to at least help others who had problems like his, but that too had disappointed him.

As intelligent as he was, he wasn’t quite at the level of the next Stephen Hawking, who won people over with his extreme intelligence. He was well above average, considered a genius, but not a prodigy like so many others.

As a result, his intelligence wasn’t enough for people to overlook his disability; they treated him like a pitiful creature, treated him like a waste of the family’s money, and called him the worst names imaginable.

After being treated like trash by so many people in his previous world and by the memories of being treated even worse in this one, he felt he just needed to live his own life and let people deal with their own problems.

However, as he instinctively focused his gaze on that spot, he noticed the thin arms and the desperate agility of the body being dragged away, and he felt sick.

The familiarity of it hit him like a punch.

’If I’m not mistaken, the one being dragged into that dark alley is the little thief who tried to rob me a few days ago, the boy who had a hungry brother and sister waiting at home...’

Lohan remembered the silent gratitude he’d seen in that child’s eyes when he gave him the nutritional supplements.

He thought of the little children who depended on that boy, who was still young enough to depend on someone older.

He thought of how disappointing it was to realize that no matter how much he wanted help, there was no one to help him in this cruel world.

Then he looked at his own hand and felt terrible.

’I used to dream that someone with the ability could help me, free me from what tormented me in my time of need... but now that I have that ability, am I going to become a selfish piece of shit who only thinks about his own personal gain? Would you be proud of who you’re becoming, Lohan?’

He let out a long, heavy sigh, already knowing the answer without even having to think too hard about it.

Feeling the Mana circulate warmly through his internal channels, preparing to integrate with Halon’s stats.

"Sigh... you really do have a knack for attracting trouble, kid..." He muttered to himself.

Resolved, Lohan clenched his fists, feeling the density of the membrane manifest beneath his skin, ready to activate the exoskeleton at any moment of crisis, as he walked silently toward the alley, planning how he could handle this while attracting the least amount of trouble for himself.

Lohan stopped at the entrance to the alley, where the darkness was so thick it would hide any crime from the average human eye, noting the irony that a society so technologically advanced still had places where technology didn’t even reach far enough to ensure the basic safety of the most vulnerable.

He activated [Thermal Vision], and the gray world of the Lower Zone was replaced by shades of cool blue, revealing four heat signatures pulsing ahead. Three of them were large and aggressive, surrounding the fourth, which was small and flickering.

Through [Spatial Echo-Location], he sensed a vibration of metal... one of the men pulled something heavy from his waist, likely an iron pipe or a cheap vibrating knife, and spoke in a threatening tone.

"Where’s the rest of the cargo, brat?" The man’s hoarse voice echoed off the peeling walls, speaking with the same arrogance that people from the Upper Zone used when addressing the Lower Zones.

Analyzing the situation, he realized that these men weren’t ordinary thugs as he’d imagined, but vultures from the outskirts—a kind of local mafia focused on stealing whatever they could from the already impoverished people of the Lower Zone.

Despite his fear and the desperate situation, Lohan saw that the little boy still stood his ground as he replied. "Let me go! I already told you there’s no rest of the loot—people aren’t foolish enough to walk around with valuables on the street anymore, Frank. Everything I managed to steal, I’ve already given to you!"

"Hahaha, really, Oliver? Then tell me, what’s that thing shining out of your backpack?" The man with the vibrating knife in his hand said, pointing at the little boy’s backpack with disdain.

Oliver, the little boy, was startled to hear that, instinctively covering his backpack and looking at it to check if nothing was actually leaking out, but seeing nothing, he felt a tightness in his chest.

’Shit...’ He thought desperately.

"Mwahaha, I told you he was just a stupid kid, boss. With your intelligence, there’s no way he can hide anything from you!" One of the other men, a bald man covered in technological implants where his hair should have been, laughed.

Frank laughed too, proudly. "You’re still too naive, Oliver. Come on, open that backpack already and give me the rest of the goods you stole. I know you’re a good thief—don’t think I’d be foolish enough to believe you only managed to steal $100 in a week. If you don’t hand over the $150 quota... you won’t make it out of this alley in one piece."

Lohan saw the fear of disappointment on the little boy’s face, but knowing there was no way out, he grabbed the backpack and prepared to open it.

Lohan was shocked to learn that this little boy managed to steal the equivalent of $150 a week in the Lower Zone, but knowing that this charade had to end now, he prepared to go deeper into the alley, only to be interrupted by the sound of an engine approaching at high speed, followed by another, and another.

Chapter 124: 124 - Silver Lotus

-- VROOOM

-- VROOOM

-- VROOOM

...

With his perception skills active, Lohan picked up a total of six distinct engine noises approaching at high speed through the skies.

Looking in that direction, he saw the source of those noises.

Riding six white sports flying motorcycles, all painted with a design of a silver lotus flower with a bright pink outline against a blue sky, the six people dressed in silver jackets skillfully maneuvered the bikes into the narrow alley, passing by where Lohan was hiding and hovering around the group of men, pointing their headlights menacingly at them.

Seeing those bikes, the eyes of Frank beneath his protective mask and those of his men narrowed, adopting a defensive stance as they drew more vibro-knives from their waists, ready to engage at any moment.

But despite his obvious concern, Frank still stepped forward and spoke in a firm voice, looking at the bike in the center of the formation.

"Skye... you know my boss won’t be happy to hear that the Silver Lotus is roaming his territory." He said, completely ignoring the other motorcycles and staring at the one in the center.

Riding that bike was a slender female figure, with a slim, pale waist hugged by a tight light pink shirt, wearing silver pants and a jacket matching the flower on the bike, with long blonde hair spilling out from under her helmet.

Despite the bulky white helmet on her head, Lohan could clearly hear a sassy female voice laughing.

"Haha, what a funny joke, Frank. Do you really think we’re afraid of your boss? That filthy sewer rat doesn’t have the guts to leave his hole even to eat, let alone do anything about us!" The girl laughed, her voice echoing through the alley via the speakers in her helmet.

At her laughter, the other five people on the motorcycle laughed too, slightly relaxing the initially tense posture they’d held, and growing more at ease against the three large men.

"Now tell me, Frank, did you get tired of stealing pension money from the elderly and decide to steal school lunch money from kids?" The girl named Skye laughed again.

Lohan noticed Frank’s hand gripping the handle of his knife even tighter, but despite his anger, he didn’t react, clearly intimidated by the six people surrounding him.

Frank gripped the handle of the vibrating knife until the knuckles on his fingers turned white, while the hissing sound of the blade echoed off the damp, moldy walls of the alley.

His muscles were taut, ready for a lunge that logic told him would be suicidal. On the other side, Skye let go of the motorcycle’s handlebars and rested her elbows there, leaning forward as if watching a very interesting performance, leaving only the static hum of the flight stabilizers to fill the tense silence.

"The territory may belong to the rat you call your boss, Frank, but the air in the Lower Zone is still free... at least for now," Skye said, tilting her head so the visor of her helmet reflected the light coming from outside the alley. "And we don’t like the smell of cowardice you guys give off when you pick on someone who can’t fight back."

One of Frank’s men took a step back, intimidated by the powerful headlights that seemed to scan every flaw in their cheap armor.

Frank growled, his voice muffled by his protective mask.

He looked at the little boy and then at the Silver Lotus’s impeccable formation, feeling powerless.

"You’re making a mistake, Skye. The Silver Lotus won’t be able to fly so high when the Atlas Group comes to collect the protection money for this area..." Frank hissed, finally relaxing his thumb on the knife’s switch. He knew that starting a fight there would result in his team being slaughtered by the riders of those sport bikes before they even managed to cross the alley.

"Tell your boss that the kid’s lunch today is on the house." Skye sneered, revving the engine briefly, sending a wave of heat and sound crashing into the men on the ground.

Frank spat into the black mold of the alley, as a final, impotent display of contempt. "Let’s go. It’s not worth wasting battery power on this silver trash. But remember... the shadows of the Lower Zone are long and deep, Skye; you can’t be everywhere at once."

With a snort, he turned and began to walk out of the alley.

His two henchmen also quickly followed the man, not even looking back.

As they left, they passed where Lohan was hiding, but none of the three noticed the man camouflaged in the shadows of that spot, using [Umbral Mimicry].

When the trio finally left, Lohan saw the motorcycle belonging to the girl named Skye descending from the sky, slowly and gently, and landing beside Oliver.

Unlike when he faced Frank, Oliver showed no fear whatsoever toward this new gang; in fact, the expression he wore now looked more like shyness and embarrassment than fear!

As she touched the ground, Skye raised her fingers and touched the back of her helmet, causing the structure to retract into the nape of her neck, revealing a beautiful, delicate face covered only by a small breathing mask that covered her mouth.

With a flick of her hand, Skye shook out her long blonde hair and looked at Oliver with a concerned smile.

"Oliver, didn’t you promise me you’d stop working for the Asphyxia Gang? I was still waiting for you with Amy and Tommy in our territory..." she said in a gentle voice as she ruffled the little boy’s thick, greasy hair, not caring about the feeling it left on her hand.

Oliver looked away but answered firmly. "I can’t steal in Lotus’s territory... if I don’t steal, how am I going to buy food for them?"

Skye stopped ruffling his hair and looked at him with mixed feelings, wanting to scold him but also understanding the heavy responsibility this little 11-year-old boy had to carry.

With a sigh, she didn’t know what to say.

Suddenly, a breeze coming from the alleyway’s entrance carried a scent that made her freeze for a second, her blue eyes flashing with alertness.

"You know what? I hate being watched by someone hiding. How about you come out of your hiding spot voluntarily before my companions drag you out here not so voluntarily?" she asked aloud, her voice a mix of coldness and playfulness.

Hearing that, the five other riders perked up, turning their bikes toward the alley entrance, trying to see who Skye was talking to.

As soon as that was said, Lohan knew she was talking to him, so he was torn.

’Should I wait and see if this is a bluff? Or try to escape from here without anyone seeing me? Or do I go out voluntarily and avoid a conspicuous chase that would draw even more unnecessary attention to me?’

Weighing the pros and cons of these options, and realizing that the people in this gang didn’t seem as bad as Frank’s group, Lohan made a decision.

Confident in his own strength, at least he didn’t feel he would be helpless in front of that group.

Chapter 125: 125 - Limit

Bringing his arm close to his face, Lohan sniffed himself, puzzled by the scent the girl had detected that gave away his position, but he couldn’t smell anything.

Only after activating [Chemosensory Aptitude] did he sense a faint trace of Mana being exhaled by his body, mainly due to the use of [Umbral Mimicry].

’Damn, I thought I was hiding well, but was I actually exposing myself even more?’

The amount of Mana in that body was so low compared to his Slime body that he hadn’t even noticed it before.

’Does she have some ability to sense the smell of Mana like I do?’ He thought in surprise, raising the danger level she posed.

To possess such a keen ability, she would need to have a Base at least at the Rare level in Elysium and a relatively high rank, and someone like that, in a group like this that already had combat experience, could be dangerous to him.

Deciding to avoid hostility, Lohan first deactivated the [Umbral Mimicry] and actively withdrew his own Mana into himself.

As a Slime, Lohan could use [Structural Stability] even within a human body to control his own body in a way that would take other people years of practice to achieve.

Once he understood how to apply this in the real world, his rate of improvement in training skyrocketed even further, as he could activate any muscle he wanted, pushing those muscles to their limit with far less effort, and used [Efficient Digestion] to nourish those muscles as quickly as possible.

The ability to control one’s own body like a Slime, which had a simple and basic structure, might not seem all that surprising or terrifying, but in a body as complex as a human’s, the power to control oneself with such precision was on a whole other level.

With his hands raised to indicate he posed no danger, Lohan approached the group slowly.

Sure, with magic within him, even those raised hands could generate [Ice Spikes] to attack at any moment, but for this group of people, seeing the way he approached was more reassuring.

Lohan was dressed entirely in black, with a cheap protective overcoat—very common in the Lower Zone—covering his body; even though the fabric was thick and bulky, one could still tell he had a well-proportioned physique.

At 1.81 meters tall (5’11"), Lohan was tall, but not intimidatingly so.

His face was covered by the most common and cheapest protective and filtering mask in the Lower Zone—precisely the mask Lohan had mocked in his college class for failing to meet the safe filtration threshold for the population.

This mask was like the gas masks he’d seen in movies from the other world: entirely black, with two circular filters over the mouth and two eye slits.

Seeing through it was terrible, but it was what people had to wear to survive in this place.

Although he looked scary to anyone else, to this Lower Zone gang, Lohan seemed like just a normal person.

"I didn’t mean any harm," Lohan said as he approached, his eyes fixed on Skye, but with his perception skills running at full throttle, analyzing everyone there.

Skye looked at him suspiciously, feeling not the slightest bit of intimacy toward his appearance, but sensing something strange about how she could no longer smell that slightly bitter scent he had been giving off just a few seconds ago.

"Then why were you watching us like a pervert?" She furrowed her brows and crossed her arms in front of her, taking a step to stand in front of Oliver.

The little boy was still a bit dazed by all the events, but as he looked at the man approaching, a vague sense of familiarity arose in his mind.

The people on the motorcycles didn’t stand still, revving their engines slightly, causing a light gust of wind in that alley, which made both Skye’s hair sway in the wind and Lohan’s clothes follow the same movement, while neither of them let it affect them.

Sighing, Lohan formulated a response. "Honestly, I didn’t even want to get involved in this. I was coming from the bus stop and saw a group of men dragging a little boy into the alley. Seeing that, something inside me screamed that I couldn’t just let it go, so I came to see if I could help."

Hearing his answer, instead of feeling impressed, Skye started laughing. "Hahaha, did you guys hear that?! Looks like the Lower Zone is going to have a hero now. I feel so safe... what about you, Jenny? Do you feel that way too?"

From one of the flying motorcycles, another woman’s laugh rang out; this one had a deeper, harsher voice, speaking with even more disdain than Skye. "Yeah, Skye, I think now that this hero is on the loose, I’ll finally be able to walk my dog outdoors without a care in the world."

Hearing their mockery, Lohan rolled his eyes, fed up with it all.

’Honestly, I owe these people nothing. I’ve already shown more than enough sincerity by approaching them without showing any hostility. If that’s how they want to treat me, then they can go to hell.’

With that thought, Lohan didn’t even bother to respond and turned around, leaving the alley.

"Wait, where do you think you’re going? Do you think I don’t know you were with those rats? I smelled something different on you, come back here... hey, I’m talking to you!" Skye started speaking arrogantly, until he realized Lohan wasn’t even listening and was already almost out of the alley.

-- Fweeeet!

Realizing he wasn’t going to stop, Skye curled her tongue inside her mouth and let out a loud whistle.

Hearing that whistle, without a single word needing to be spoken, two motorcycles broke away from the flying formation and in an instant passed over Lohan, blocking his path out of the alley.

"I didn’t say you could leave. Come back here and behave yourself." Skye said with disdain again.

This time, Lohan didn’t even feel indifferent anymore; a rage built up by the attitude of the people in this world began to rise in his chest, compounded by the arrogance and domineering nature Skye was displaying, causing him to clench his fists tightly just as Frank had done. But instead of feeling helpless and hesitant, the battle instinct honed to the limit over the past few days in Elysium kicked in.

Without him realizing it, his mindset suddenly shifted to that of [Predator], observing these people and analyzing how he could deal with them as prey.

’Fuck all this bullshit about hiding my own strength; in this dark alley there are no cameras, no one here has seen my face or knows who I am... I’m training to become stronger in Elysium not just for the money, but for freedom. Freedom that the power that world gives me, freedom from being forced to follow foolish, arrogant, and authoritarian people like that girl.’

With his mind made up, Lohan stopped hesitating.

Knowing no combat stance, he did what he knew best... activating dozens of evolutions at once, ceasing to be a weak and vulnerable creature, to become the hunter with dozens, if not hundreds, of monster kills to his name.

Chapter 126: 126 - Clash

Skye watched as the man was surrounded by Jenny and Kai, a smile on her face.

Even though she wasn’t on her own turf, she wasn’t the least bit afraid of the rats who ruled this area.

A few months ago, she might have felt a little intimidated by the numbers the men here commanded; though weak in individual strength, in a group fight they could prove very dominant.

But after she experienced Elysium through a stolen helmet that the Silver Lotus had intercepted, Skye felt it would only be a matter of time before she completely dominated the Lower Zone, establishing herself as the sole dominant voice in this wretched place and bringing real improvement to the people here.

Upon discovering the advantages of this game, Skye wasn’t selfish and let everyone in the Silver Lotus share the helmet, also creating characters in that game and slowly becoming more powerful both in the game and, surprisingly, in real life.

Since reducing each person’s playtime would slow down their rate of progress, it would be much better for Silver Lotus to improve their collective power by a small margin than to have only her with individual power far above the rest; after all, she couldn’t be everywhere at once.

Unfortunately, she discovered that unlike her—who received a large portion of the power obtained in the virtual world in the real world—most of the gang members received only a small fraction of that, with rare exceptions like Zach, Jenny, and Sara, who had an Uncommon Class, a Rare Class, and a Rare Race, respectively.

From what she understood, the higher a Player’s Base in Elysium, the greater the level of power that person could wield in the real world, and as a Player with an Epic Race, the level of power her real body received was far greater than that of everyone else.

That was why she was confident she could dominate the Lower Zone.

Given how rare people with powers like hers were, and how expensive Elysium’s neural helmets were, so far this man was the only person from whom she had sensed the slightly bitter scent of dark Mana.

And because of that scent, she was almost certain that this man was part of the Asphyxia Gang’s sewer rats... having only ever sensed that scent on dark monsters in Elysium, she couldn’t imagine a good person having a scent like that.

Seeing how the man stopped when surrounded by Jenny and Kai, Skye grew even happier, eager to see him finally submit.

With the hatred she felt for the Asphyxia Gang—after everything they’d done to her and her sister—seeing one of their members suffer was deeply satisfying to her.

But suddenly, a wave of odors far more intense than the previous one she had sensed flooded her senses.

The slightly bitter smell wasn’t even present this time, but rather a mixture of sweet, acidic, metallic, sour smells... and others that at that point she couldn’t even distinguish!

’What’s happening? How is he producing so many different smells?!’ She was shocked.

All the monsters or people she had faced in Elysium usually had a unique, distinctive scent.

People involved in nature magic had the fresh scent of wet leaves; people involved in fire magic had pungent scents; monsters related to wind elements had soft, fresh scents; while the monsters with dark elements she had encountered had a slightly bitter scent, like that of this man she had found.

Smelling that scent, Skye had already formed a prejudice against him, thinking he was a Player involved with dark magic, and since Elysium’s AI provided hints based on a person’s personality, having a scent like that only further confirmed that this man was not a good person.

But this flood of different scents completely shattered her theory.

---

There she was, sensing the scents of wildflowers and morning dew—an ethereal sweetness reminiscent of the pure vitality of an untouched forest, emanating from the [Natural Energy Core] pulsing beneath his skin.

Soon after, Skye felt the air suddenly turn cold, laden with a metallic scent of ozone, like polar air before a snowstorm, stemming from Lohan’s affinity with the ice magic of his [Magic Core].

Behind that lay the dry, mineral scent of volcanic ash, exuded by the density of the [Obsidian Exoskeleton].

Finally, a sour, viscous note of concentrated poison rose up her nostrils.

’This is impossible!’ She grew more and more shocked with every new layer of scent she sensed.

That man didn’t give off the scent of a single Base or element... he smelled like an entire ecosystem compressed into a single vessel!

As Skye tried to process that sensory overload, she noticed that despite his seemingly slovenly posture, he gave off the impression of being ready to attack at any moment.

Not only did Skye realize that this man was ready for combat, but Jenny and Kai, who were blocking Lohan’s path, realized it too.

Confident in Elysium’s newly acquired power, neither of them hesitated.

Especially Jenny, who had a Rare Class, which meant she received even greater power from the game; with a quick thought, she accelerated the motorcycle forward, ready to attack this "sewer rat."

"WAI..." Skye’s scream hadn’t even finished when the scene in front of her took a dramatic turn!

Jenny revved the sport bike, its jet engine emitting a high-pitched screech that echoed off the damp walls of the alley. To her, Lohan was just a stationary target, a "rat" about to be run over by the technological superiority and superior power of a Rare Player like her.

However, Lohan didn’t back down... his muscles contracted in perfect synchrony, preparing a response that defied common perception.

In the millisecond the motorcycle was about to strike him, Lohan utilized the integration of Halon’s stats to reinforce his current physical structure, activating [Body Density] to the limit available in the real world, feeling his muscles suddenly become heavy and rigid as rock, increasing his inertial mass.

With an almost imperceptible movement, he fired a single strand of [Magic Weaving], so thin it was invisible in the twilight, latching it directly onto the motorcycle’s side stabilizer while twisting his body with the agility of [Viscous Flow].

Although the weight and exertion were too much for his body, causing intense muscle pain, the motorcycle did not hit him; instead, the thread anchored to Lohan’s massive weight acted like an arresting hook on an aircraft carrier.

The vehicle jolted violently in the air, losing its stabilizing balance.

Jenny was thrown forward by the impact of inertia, flying over the handlebars before crashing awkwardly into a pile of metal boxes.

The flying, out-of-control motorcycle spun in the air and scraped its left side against the rough brick wall, producing a screeching sound of metal being torn apart that completely destroyed the silver Lotus Flower’s paint job.

Kai, seeing his partner knocked down so humiliatingly, roared with fury and leaped off his own bike, charging forward on foot with a punch charged with energy.

Lohan dealt with him in a manner opposite to Jenny’s aggression.

Instead of dodging, he simply raised his right palm. At the moment of impact, Lohan activated [Non-Newtonian Resilience] and the [Obsidian Exoskeleton] just beneath the skin of his palm, making it as rigid as volcanic rock.

Kai’s punch struck Lohan’s hand with a sharp crack, but the humanoid Slime didn’t even move his arm. It felt like he had punched a tank’s armor plate!

Lohan clamped his fingers around Kai’s wrist with a strength far beyond that of a normal human. Kai paled as he realized that, despite facing a relatively thin man from the Lower Zone, the strength holding his arm was definitely superhuman... and worse, on a higher level than his own!

"I remember you!" Suddenly, a high-pitched, surprised voice interrupted the fight.
