Chapter 128: 128 - Magic Bath

On his way home, Lohan took off his heavy protective gear—which was useless to him at that moment—and lay down on his bed, staring at the ceiling and replaying what had just happened in his mind.

’They always warned me that this hero’s life was thankless...’ he thought before letting out a sigh.

But despite everything that had happened, Lohan didn’t regret going to help.

He hadn’t known that gang would show up to help the little boy, and if they hadn’t, Lohan would have felt terrible knowing he had the power to help a defenseless child but chose to turn a blind eye and not help.

Thinking about that strange gang in their flashy clothes and on their fancy motorcycles, Lohan was surprised to discover that there were people like that in the Lower Zone.

As far as he could remember, in this end-of-the-world place there were only bad people, people who had given up on life, or people deluded by the hope of a better future.

Obviously, that group belonged to the latter category.

But Lohan didn’t feel like mocking them.

They were banding together to fight for something they believed was right, chasing their dreams as best they could, not worrying about pursuing a conventional career or earning a mediocre salary that would only further enrich the exploiters of the Upper Zone.

That was a very commendable attitude, but it wasn’t something Lohan believed in or wanted to be a part of.

He didn’t feel that the Lower Zone was his home, nor did he care enough about the people around him to go out of his way to improve their lives.

He didn’t even know or care about his neighbors, let alone millions of people he’d never heard of.

And the fact that the people he encountered outside his apartment wore masks and baggy clothes only made that feeling of indifference toward them even stronger.

’Is this on purpose?’ he thought, surprised, but not giving it much thought.

But witnessing such a strange scene today had stirred something in him.

’What am I looking for in this world?’ he asked himself.

Sure, he really enjoyed playing in Elysium; the sense of growing stronger as he leveled up, buying upgrades with biomass, and killing more powerful monsters—all of that was a lot of fun.

But despite the fun it brought, Lohan still hadn’t found a purpose in it all.

Lisa’s arrival was a blessing.

At first, he didn’t care one bit about the guild she wanted to form. As a loner in this other world, the idea of forming a guild and leading people was something that had never crossed his mind.

But as time went on, the camaraderie he developed with that cold yet cute fox began to create something more within him, showing him that life with other people was much more fun than the solitude of just chewing grass every day, as he had done before.

In recent days, he found himself thinking more and more about Astralis Requiem. Thinking about what he could do to improve the guild, thinking about what it would be like to see that tree they had claimed full of people—full of people who might like him and care about him the way few people ever had in either of his lives...

’It’s as if I feel more alive, more at home when I’m in Elysium than when I’m in the real world... or maybe I should stop calling it the real world and just call it This World?’ he wondered.

Considering how Lisa treated Elysium, it was possible that his hypothesis was more accurate than continuing to call Elysium a virtual world.

He was already almost certain that Elysium was another world that humanity had somehow managed to make contact with and was slowly invading, but the idea of that was still so far removed from his reality.

"Phew... maybe I’m overthinking this. I’m still in my third week in this world; I think I’m once again demanding too much of myself. It’s better to just let things take their course while I enjoy the journey, rather than just focusing on a distant goal," he said in a low voice.

As he spoke those words, Lohan even felt as if a weight had lifted from his chest, as if something pleasant had touched him and untied a knot he hadn’t even known had formed.

After the battle he’d had in the alley, Lohan realized how important personal development was and drank a nutritional supplement while pushing himself to the limit during his workouts.

After those weeks of training, Lohan already felt that the technique and quality of every exercise he did were much better.

His body, with such abundant nutrition available at every meal, was also being reshaped almost visibly. Even more so with the specific and general workouts he was able to do at high intensity, even without the use of equipment thanks to his body control.

After finishing these exercises, Lohan decided to test a new idea.

Instead of taking a shower and wasting money on water, he remembered how he used to clean himself as a Slime, simply digesting any particles of dirt that stuck to him, and wondered if something like that would also work in the real world.

Looking at his sweaty arm, Lohan used the same instinct he used in Elysium to try to digest the sweat, but even after a minute, nothing happened.

’Strange... what’s the problem?’ He was confused.

Bringing his arm to his mouth, Lohan gave the sweat a light lick and realized he really could digest it—the problem was that he had to bring it to his mouth.

’Ohh, the Slime can digest anything that comes into contact with its body, since the jelly all over its body is like a digestive acid... but my human body doesn’t have that convenience... but wait, what if I try something.’

---

Lohan looked very closely at his own arm, focusing on the sensation of Mana circulating through the internal channels of his body, much like it did in Slime’s body.

He realized that, although human skin was a solid and restrictive barrier, the pores were natural openings he could exploit.

The first attempt was still crude... he tried simply to "push" the Mana out through his skin, but he only felt an uncomfortable heat and his muscles contracted without any practical result.

Frustrated, Lohan took a deep breath, activating [Structural Stability] to steady his breathing and focus on the cellular structure of his own dermis.

This time he changed his strategy and, instead of expelling pure energy, focused on the sweat glands, trying to saturate the sweat already covering his arm with the Mana from his [Magic Core].

After several minutes of intense concentration, tiny droplets of visibly denser, slightly bluish sweat began to emerge, laden with a massive concentration of Mana and, surprisingly, a bit of biomass!

The next challenge was controlling it.

In Elysium, his gelatin was his own body, something he’d already had great control over since he first appeared there on Level 01, but here, sweat was merely an external secretion.

Using the logic of [Structural Stability] and the trait of [Morphological Memory], Lohan tried to extend his will beyond his skin, treating the liquid on his arm as an extension of his own biomass, viewing that Mana- and Biomass-rich sweat as a true extension of himself.

The first time, the sweat simply trickled down and fell to the floor, but on the third attempt, he managed to keep the liquid film adhering to his arm through a rudimentary form of [Selective Viscosity].

With the Mana-rich sweat under control, Lohan finally activated [Efficient Digestion] through that thin fluid layer.

The effect was astonishing! As soon as the Mana in the sweat came into contact with the dirt and grease particles, the [Digestive Filter] identified the unwanted components and decomposed them at the molecular level, just as he used to do as a Slime.

His muscles relaxed as he watched the dirt simply vanish, leaving his skin impeccably clean and a sensation of renewed freshness coursing through his entire arm—far better than bathing in the dirty water of the Lower Zone.

He smiled contentedly, realizing he had just created a self-sufficient hygiene method that not only cleaned him better than anything he’d ever seen, but also subtly improved his Mana control!

Chapter 129: 129 - The Matriarch Returns

"Aaaahhhh, I want to kill him!!!" A shrill, furious voice rang out in the Silverport church.

Looking at the rage of that reborn person who had just appeared there, the church priest let out a sigh, but surprisingly accustomed to this kind of behavior, he acted very naturally as he guided the young priestesses to make room for that person to calm down before proceeding with the rebirth process.

Ever since the Goddess issued a decree warning that people from another world would appear in Elysium, and that when these people died they would be reborn in her churches, there had been great concern and shock among the believers.

Initially, they thought these people would be like church missionaries—divine, pure, and holy beings who would help bring peace to Elysium.

But after the initial contact, it became clear that these people from another world were not what they had imagined.

The first people they met acted like ordinary people—very serious and busy, but with a normal sense of respect.

The problem was that among that group of people, there were also those with identities similar to those of nobles, who, upon dying and being reborn in the churches, became enraged, trying to smash everything without fear of the consequences, enraged at losing the rare Race they had, forcing church members to keep them in captivity for a while, both to calm them down and to make them pay for the damage they caused.

These people did not take confinement very well, becoming more and more aggressive as time went on, to the point of giving up, turning into blue lights, and disappearing in front of everyone.

Only to return a few hours later, or the next day, this time calmer, but still angry and thirsty for revenge.

With the increase in these cases, dealing with these people had become more of a headache than an honor bestowed by the Goddess.

"Judging by that woman’s furious scream, it looks like we’ll have another complicated case today..." A young priestess sighed.

The priest watched the woman, who was now pounding the stone wall of Silverport Cathedral with clenched fists, screaming about a certain "Halon" and a "damned fox."

For the locals, the scene was a vivid and painful reminder that the "Goddess’s Envoys" were beings driven by a logic that defied their mortal sanity.

He knew that, for these Otherworlders, death was not the end, but a bitter new beginning that often shattered the pride and power they carried.

From the distorted aura the woman exuded, the priest realized she was acting like someone who had lost something immensely valuable.

Perhaps a divine blessing that the Goddess would not grant again, now relegating her to a common and fragile existence, as had happened to others enraged in recent days.

That was what fueled these people’s fury: the abrupt fall from "divine nobility" to "common rabble" in a single moment of failure.

The Goddess, in her infinite wisdom above the clouds, had warned that these billions of mortals would be the salvation against the creatures of the void, but to the simple servants of the church, they seemed more like a plague of powerful and unstable children.

The phenomenon that believers called "Stellar Retreat"—when these beings transformed into blue particles and vanished before everyone’s eyes—was what disturbed the clergy the most.

They did not understand that the Otherworlders were merely returning to the "real world"; to the faithful, the Goddess was pulling them back to purify their minds before returning them to the world, often much calmer.

"Prepare the containment seals and the Mana incense," the priest ordered in a low voice to the priestesses. "She will soon become light and leave us for a time. Let us pray that, when she returns, she does not try to set the city ablaze in search of this Halon fellow..."

But to the priest’s surprise, the woman who had been screaming hysterically with rage suddenly stared into the void before her, and her eyes—which had been filled with fury and despair—now shone with excitement.

"Are you kidding me?! After dying, I only lost my Race?! My Matriarch Class is still with me?!" The woman spoke to herself, not caring one bit about the people around her.

Confirming that she still had access to her skills, despite having dropped from Level 10 to Level 09, Brynn was amazed!

"Now that I no longer have to deal with the stinky, ugly body of a Beetle, my Matriarch Class can wield even greater power!" she realized excitedly! 𝒻𝑟𝘦𝘦𝘸ℯ𝒷𝑛𝘰𝓋ℯ𝘭.𝘤𝘰𝘮

"MWAHAHAHAHA! Halon, you son of a bitch, I’m going to end your life!!!" She laughed and shouted excitedly, no longer showing the fury she had felt just a few minutes ago.

Seeing that strange change in attitude, the priest was confused, no longer sure whether he should arrest this Otherworlder, or if he could consider her sane enough to be allowed to leave the church.

Suddenly, the woman looked up and stared at the priest.

Seeing that he was just an "NPC," she acted with disdain, not even bothering to speak to him, and walked away gracefully.

Unlike the large, deformed body she had as Queen Beetle, Brynn had now taken on a physical form that resembled 80% of her appearance in the real world.

She had long black hair with deep purplish hues that framed a pale, aristocratic face characteristic of the people of the Upper Zone.

Her eyes were a vibrant, piercing purple, shining with the same intensity and malice she displayed when commanding the beetle army.

She wore a dark, sophisticated outfit, composed of layers of fine fabrics with blue and purple details, which accentuated the slender silhouette she now possessed as a human.

Walking with a grace impossible to display as a Beetle Queen, Brynn ignored the priest’s presence, focused solely on her plans for revenge against Halon and that damned fox.

And upon seeing a group of people dressed like her, acting exactly like the people of the Upper Zone she knew, a confident smile appeared on the woman’s face.

[NunuNote: To clarify, as mentioned earlier in the novel, a Player can strive in the game to achieve higher-rarity Classes, as happened with a college student who became a knight’s squire and saw his class change from Common to Uncommon. Following this logic, when a Player dies, they lose their Race and revert to being human, but the Class is still retained. (Since it wouldn’t make sense to lose that.) I hope that made sense to you all <3]

"Are you sure that was an oracle from the Goddess?" A girl with squirrel ears on her head asked in surprise, looking at her friend who was wearing healer’s robes.

The healer nodded quickly and replied worriedly in a low voice. "Yes, from what I’ve heard, this information is being disseminated by all the churches of the Goddess Astraea with high priority... even the nobles are already holding meetings to decide how they’ll handle this, since such a large influx of people from another world appearing in the cities could cause a lot of chaos."

This answer piqued the curiosity of the girl with squirrel ears even more, causing her to look around excitedly as if trying to spot someone different who matched what she’d heard in the news. 𝒻𝑟𝘦𝘦𝘸ℯ𝒷𝑛𝘰𝓋ℯ𝘭.𝘤𝘰𝘮

Unfortunately, aside from the ordinary people who frequented Thalendor, the only beings slightly different from the norm were a small white fox carrying a tiny blue Slime on its back.

Thinking about how the people from another world had been described by her friend, she didn’t even consider that these two small creatures were part of that group.

Not only because of the fox, but the idea that a Slime could have an identity as unique and prestigious as that of someone personally brought from another world by the Goddess Astraea herself was inconceivable.

What she didn’t know was that the said Slime had overheard her conversation with her friend and was surprised.

"Did you hear that, Lisa?" Lohan asked.

"Yes... I knew that eventually the news about the Players would reach the cities of the Open World, but I didn’t imagine it would spread so fast... it seems that the arrival of other Players to the Open World is accelerating the spread of this." Lisa replied through their mental link.

She wasn’t even running through the city, so there was no need to carry Halon on her back, but considering how used to it they both were, she didn’t even realize he could get off her back and roll around.

The same was true for Lohan, who had also grown accustomed to the convenience of moving on Lisa’s back, like a mount; he didn’t feel the need to get off her back to move on his own.

Considering that he was treating a Legendary Fox like a mount, one could say that at least among the Players, no one had a mount as luxurious as his.

"Will new Players appear in Thalendor?" Lohan asked curiously, thinking about the possibility of finding new potential members for Astralis Requiem.

Lisa was a bit pensive about this, but soon replied. "Well, my employees and followers will soon arrive in Thalendor after following me on the friends list, so at least those people are guaranteed. As for random Players, I believe only a small minority spawn here, since Thalendor is a major metropolis; for someone to come to this city as their starting city in the Open World, those people must have either done something exceptional in Novato Village, or they must have a very high rarity level that matches the environment here."

Hearing that, Lohan realized she had mentioned something he had never asked about. "Speaking of your employees and associates... is there anything I should keep in mind? After all, I’m the Vice President of Astralis Requiem, right? It would be strange not to know how to act around these people who would be joining us."

Lohan’s question struck a nerve with Lisa.

’I should tell him that I’m representing a branch of the Vance Group... but if he knew my real-world identity, would he act differently toward me?’

This was something Lisa had found herself thinking about more recently than she’d imagined.

Theoretically, her relationship with Halon was strictly that of business partners, but considering how close they’d become in recent days—with Halon’s casual way of treating her as if she were just a normal girl—Lisa was putting off sharing this information longer than she should have, so as not to lose that feeling.

The problem was that with the arrival of the new members, eventually this news would spread.

Getting her employees to keep quiet about the Vance Group was possible, but the problem was the "Associates" she mentioned.

These associates weren’t people who depended on her or had to obey her every order; in fact, her two associates were her only two friends in the real world!

Commanding them the way she did her employees was something she vehemently refused to do.

Even though she knew they would obey her without hesitation, given the respect they had for her family, it was precisely because of that she didn’t want to make such a request.

It had already been very difficult to get them to treat her the way they did now—as what she considered the closest thing to a normal girl she had ever felt in her life—but there would always be a distance between them because of the respect they felt.

After meeting Halon, her fear that he would become like them only intensified even more.

Recently, she’d even had to restrain herself from sending him messages on Syn after something interesting happened to her in the real world... something that had never happened before!

In the past, it was always other people who sent her the first messages, trying to strike up a conversation with her for various reasons, but ever since she added him on Syn, that clueless Slime hadn’t even considered sending her a message!

Noticing that the fox’s mind had drifted off into thoughts, Lohan assumed she was processing important information about the new Guild members and didn’t interrupt her, simply enjoying the walk while continuing to digest the Beetle corpses.

Although it seemed like a simple and rather useless item with many vulnerabilities, the Astral Chest was like a perfect treasure to him, allowing him to maintain constant digestion even inside Thalendor.

With this constant digestion, Lohan had already accumulated over 3,000 Biomass to purchase evolutions.

Too tired to choose what to evolve yesterday, today was finally the day Lohan decided to spend that large amount of Biomass and upgrade himself significantly.

Taking advantage of Lisa’s mental distraction, Lohan opened his list of evolutions and, without hesitation, spent Biomass like a child in a toy store after receiving Christmas money from generous grandparents!

Chapter 131: 131 - Big Spending!

[Enjoy your bonus Chapter from the Power Stones Goal!]

Looking at the blue windows glowing before him, if Lohan had eyes, they would be shining right now.

The first expense went toward the Skill that had accelerated Lohan’s evolution so much at the start of Elysium that, despite the high cost, Lohan spent 1,792 Biomass to evolve it to Level 11 without hesitation.

[After 10 minor evolutions, Passive Digestion is undergoing a qualitative evolution...]

[Passive Digestion Lv 8 → Lv 11] - 2,048 Biomass

[New trait obtained: Passive Digestion Engine!]

[Features: Passive Digestion Engine: By consuming external energy, the user’s Passive Digestion rate can be accelerated!]

Reading the description of this feature, he got very excited!

Even though it explained almost nothing, Lohan instinctively felt that now he could use Mana to accelerate the speed of his passive digestion!

Concentrating for a second, Lohan controlled his own Mana to flow into his core, focused on fueling the [Passive Digestion]; the more Mana he injected, the faster his digestion speed rose!

Unfortunately, after continuously injecting Mana there, at one point Lohan felt a saturation and realized he had reached a limit.

Weighing the cost and the gain, Lohan calculated that he could double the speed of Passive Digestion from 68.71 Bio/h to 137.41 Bio/h in exchange for roughly 1 Mana/h!

The cost wasn’t that high for such a massive increase in Biomass gain!

Looking at the next Skill, Lohan decided to invest 449 Biomass to achieve another qualitative evolution.

[After 10 minor evolutions, Body Density is undergoing a qualitative evolution...]

[Body Density Lv 10 → Lv 16] - 179.37 Biomass

[New trait obtained: Gravitational Anchoring!]

[Traits: Gravitational Anchoring - When activating this trait, the user’s internal density increases slightly, making it difficult to be moved by external forces, kinetic impacts, or lower-level repulsion magic.]

Reading the new trait he had obtained, Lohan would be smiling if he had a mouth right now.

This skill might not seem like much, but he could already think of several applications for it in combat!

Despite having spent a lot of biomass, Lohan decided to focus on one of his greatest allies in combat.

Spending another 751 Biomass, Lohan felt a slight twinge of regret, but he didn’t hesitate.

With the evolutions of this skill, Lohan had spent 2,992 Biomass in total, but considering how much his digestion speed would increase after this, he didn’t regret it one bit.

[After 10 minor evolutions, Partial Division is undergoing a qualitative evolution...]

[Partial Division Lv 7 → Lv 11] - 432.46 Bio

[New trait obtained: Mental Connection!]

[Traits: Mental Connection - Biological extensions (clones) now possess the ability to transfer biomass over a distance! A portion of this biomass is lost in the transfer, but physical contact is no longer absolutely necessary.]

[NunuNote: I used this trait in a previous Chapter without realizing it; I went back to edit that part so Lohan could deal with the enemy differently, but the result was still the same, so you don’t need to worry.]

Reading that new feature, Lohan was so happy he had to restrain himself from unleashing several clones right here and now.

Not only could he now transfer biomass between himself and the clone almost via Bluetooth—which was ironic considering his color—but the number of clones he could generate and control had also increased!

With the upgrades from all these evolutions, Lohan’s digestion speed rose from the previous nearly 2,000 biomass per hour (with active hemolymphatic tissue) to 2,980 Bio/h currently with Passive Digestion powered by Mana!

Without that power, digestion dropped to 2,518 Bio/h, which was still very good!

If it weren’t for having little biomass available right now, Lohan would like to buy even more evolutions, but he’d have to wait a few hours to become more powerful again.

"Hehe, I’m gaining almost 3,000 biomass per hour now... if I told that to the little Slime from a week ago who was digesting grass to get 0.1 biomass, he’d go crazy!"

With the snowball rolling, Lohan wasn’t even that concerned anymore with minor effects that might be more efficient in the evolutions he bought.

Digesting as much biomass per hour as he was now, Lohan could practically buy any Evolution he wanted at any time!

Every minute, his stored Biomass increased by 49!

Unfortunately, before he could spend any more Biomass, Lisa stopped walking, indicating that they had arrived at their destination.

After creating the Astralis Requiem, Lohan and Lisa weren’t satisfied with their power level, and they knew that the few silver coins they had would be practically nothing when they had to invest in the dozens or even hundreds of players who would join their guild, so they decided to accomplish both of these goals at the same time.

And for that, they returned to the Silver Crucible.

Seeing the small duo enter the shop, Intervar, who was assisting a customer, waved politely at them, asking with his eyes for them to wait a moment while he finished dealing with that customer.

Neither Lohan nor Lisa minded this, looking around the shop with interest at the items.

But contrary to what they imagined, the customer talking to Intervar also saw the pair, and instead of thinking they were just two little monsters, that customer sensed the intensity of the power they carried and was shocked.

"Intervar, my friend, would you mind introducing me to these noble guests?" the man asked with interest.

With wrinkles on his face and long gray hair, the man held a large staff in one hand and a dusty book strapped to his waist. He wore a majestic blue cloak, the perfect embodiment of a wizard.

To the man, that small pair posed no threat, since although they were obviously powerful for the age they appeared to be, to someone of that wizard’s caliber, the pair was no different from ants.

But even so, the man did not act arrogantly. Quite the contrary; despite his great strength, he acted with great politeness and courtesy.

Chapter 132: 132 - Contract

Looking at the mage standing before them, Lohan felt curious and slightly suspicious, not expecting to have caught the interest of that strange human.

Intervar wiped a bead of sweat from his forehead, surprised by the attention one of his most important clients was paying to his "little suppliers."

Intervar knew that the little Slime and the Fox were very special, on a level far above other Slimes and Foxes he had seen in the past, but he hadn’t thought it would be to this extent.

Although he dealt with alchemical items closely related to magic, Intervar had little interest in magic itself. As a member of such a long-lived race, he had obviously studied magic, but he had never invested much in that study, limiting himself to only the basics.

He made a formal gesture of introduction. "Lady Lisa, Lord Halon, allow me to introduce Archmage Joseph. He is one of the rare humans who has free access to the research towers of Thalendor due to his profound knowledge of mana flows."

Joseph bowed his head slightly, his piercing blue gaze fixed on Halon’s pulsating core. "Intervar is generous with his words, but the truth is that I rarely see anything that makes me question my books," said the mage in a voice aged yet still full of vigor. "However, this little... Halon... possesses an internal architecture that defies common magical geometry. I sense not one, but multiple mana pathways operating in a synchrony I’ve only seen in ancient artificial constructs!"

The old man was not only shocked by those multiple mana pathways within the Slime’s body, but he was also shocked by the mana and energy circulating through that small body every second!

Lisa maintained a defensive posture, her eyes narrowed to slits as she watched the human warily. Knowing human nature, she wasn’t fooled by his polite demeanor and the kind words he spoke.

"What would a scholar of your stature want with ’monsters’ from a fledgling forest, Archmage Joseph?" Lisa asked telepathically, keeping her tone cold.

Alaric let out a short, polite laugh. "It is merely a purely academic interest," he said, shifting his gaze to the small white fox without any apparent hostility, then continued. "I represent a school of magic in the city of Oakhaven, a human settlement that values balance and trade, unlike other more barbaric human cities you may have heard of."

He then pulled a small cold-iron pendant with an identification rune from his cloak.

"I don’t want to rush your journey; I imagine Thalendor still has much to teach you. But if one day you decide the forests have become too small, or if you need access to human libraries, take this seal." He handed the object to the small, gelatinous hand Halon had formed, causing the man’s eyes to shine even brighter in surprise.

"In Oakhaven, this seal isn’t as noble or important as Thalendor’s identity cards, but at least it will ensure you’re treated with respect regardless of your origins."

Halon stored the pendant in the [Astral Chest], not caring much about it, having no desire to leave Thalendor for human settlements in the near future.

With so many bad experiences dealing with humans, he was in no hurry to go to a place full of them.

But despite his distrust of humans, Lohan wouldn’t act arrogantly toward someone who was treating him so well, so he replied through the mental link. "Thank you for the gift, Archmage Joseph. Unfortunately, I have nothing of equal value to return this kindness."

Hearing that clear display of intelligence, Joseph was even more enchanted and curious about that fascinating creature, hoping the day the Slime would go to Oakhaven would come soon.

Seeing that no one intended to prolong the conversation, he paid for the purchases he’d made with Intervar and left the store.

Lisa kept her eyes on the old man’s back until he disappeared from view, but Lohan was already arguing with Intervar about their next "mission."

Determined to accumulate as much money as possible while gaining enough experience to level up twice, Lohan didn’t want to waste time having to travel back and forth to Thalendor so often, so he asked a bold question.

"Intervar, instead of recommending a monster for us to hunt, why don’t you give us a list of which monsters you need hunted, and we’ll bring you the ones we find along the way?"

Intervar paused for a moment with his quill suspended in the air as he processed the Slime’s request. Usually, hunters asked for recommendations based on what was easiest or most profitable at the moment, but Lohan was proposing something that resembled a continuous supply contract.

"A complete list?" Intervar let out a short laugh, but his eyes sparkled with the same business acumen Lohan had demonstrated earlier. "Halon, if you can guarantee the purity you brought in the snake acid, I could give you a list that would keep an army busy for months. The Silver Crucible always needs Amber Golem Hearts, Ether Butterfly Essence, among many other things.

Lohan stirred the jelly excitedly, feeling he was on the right track. As Intervar began jotting down the items on a parchment of tracing paper, Lohan sent a private thought to Lisa through the mental link.

"Lisa, if we can get this list now, it won’t just be a profit for us. When your employees and the new members of Astralis Requiem arrive in the Open World, they’ll already have a ’mission board’ ready and a stable source of income waiting for them."

He thought about his own $912 monthly debt in the real world and how stability was the most valuable resource for those starting from scratch.

Then he continued. "We don’t even need to maintain exclusivity with Intervar; using the success story we’re establishing here, securing contracts with other shops in different areas can bring a wide variety of ’quests’ for future guild members."

If the guild had contracts with elite shops like Intervar’s, they wouldn’t just be "just another group of monsters," but could develop into a mercenary pillar of Thalendor, gradually increasing their influence in the city and opening more and more doors.

Lisa, who until then had maintained an expression of aristocratic coolness, turned her fox-like head to face Lohan. Her silver eyes sparkled with genuine surprise and a hint of admiration.

She had expected Lohan to be a formidable combat partner because of his Mythical Race, but seeing him think about the logistical infrastructure and the future of the guild members was something she hadn’t even considered this Slime would do!

"You’re really taking the role of Vice-Leader seriously, aren’t you?" Her telepathic voice sounded sweeter and less icy than usual. "Establishing a supply chain even before our members spawn... you’re proving me more and more right in my choice, Halon."

Intervar handed the scroll to the small blue hand Lohan had formed. "Here you go. If you bring any of these in large quantities, I’ll pay you the listed price in silver coins, and know that this time we won’t need to haggle because I’m being completely sincere about this."

After glancing at the scroll and confirming that the price this time was indeed fair, Lohan stored the scroll in the guild’s [Astral Chest].

With that settled, the two left Thalendor ready to grind, while they waited and prepared for the group that, according to Lisa, would likely arrive in two days.

Chapter 133: 133 - More Evolutions!

Leaving Thalendor, the two wasted no time and rushed toward the nearest monsters on the list Intervar had compiled for them.

Considering that the rarity level of ingredients was usually directly proportional to the monsters’ level, but in rare cases some more expensive ingredients could be obtained from lower-level monsters, it was exactly those monsters that Lohan and Lisa would focus on.

Unlike her children, she had the misfortune of obtaining only an Uncommon Race and a Rare Class.

That might even seem good, but since she knew that obtaining a Rare Class, for someone with the resources she had, was only a matter of time, this was a huge disappointment, especially since the difficulty of advancing to an Epic Class was several times greater.

And even with her Rare Base, she was already growing much faster than people with Common or Uncommon Bases; the growth of an Epic Base was surreal, and that of a Legendary Base like Isabella’s was unimaginable to her—and knowing there was still something above that...

"You made the right choice, Bella... I’m so proud of you." Evelyn then smiled at the girl and gave her a hug, happy with how mature her daughter was becoming, and with the quick thinking she had demonstrated in a moment of crisis when rejected by Halon.

The only thing she wouldn’t tolerate would be if Isabella had handed over the Guild President seat to an unknown player, but anything short of that would be completely acceptable.

Then she noticed another important point in what her daughter had said. "But confirm one thing for me... did you just say you’re playing with him every day?"

That was the moment Isabella acted most naturally. "Of course, with the duo of a Legendary Fox and a Mythic Slime, our growth has accelerated to an absurd level. Even though we were only playing as a duo, now that we’ve developed our synergy, I’m sure our leveling speed won’t be second to anyone."

Hearing that, Evelyn smiled once more. "Developed your synergy, huh? And what exactly do you two do together to develop it so much?"

"Moooommmm!!!" Isabella complained once more, drawing a laugh from Evelyn, who finally stopped teasing the girl but was still determined to better understand who this Slime was that was making her little daughter act so differently from usual.

Chapter 143: 143 - Break-in

[NunuNote: Enjoy this Bonus Chapter for your Power Stone Goal!]

While Isabella and Evelyn were back to having a more "normal" conversation, Lohan, who had also logged off from Elysium at that moment, was working out when suddenly...

Ding, Dong...

The doorbell rang.

Glancing at the time and seeing that it was already one in the morning, he sensed that something was wrong.

As the intercom screen updated to show who was on the other side of the door, the doorbell rang twice more, revealing the impatience of whoever was there.

The intercom screen switched to the swollen, sweaty face of Oscar, the owner of the apartment where Lohan lived.

Unlike their previous encounter, where he had merely exuded the rudeness of a greedy landlord, now his eyes were dilated and red, darting erratically as he sniffed constantly.

The hologram over his left eye flickered in an unstable yellow hue, reflecting the nervous agitation of someone under the influence of heavy chemical stimulants.

Lohan felt a tightness in his chest, but it wasn’t the paralyzing fear from before. Thanks to the enhancements he’d received from Elysium, his senses picked up the acrid smell of sweat and synthetic substances wafting from under the door even before he opened it.

As soon as Lohan unlocked the door, Oscar shoved it open forcefully, bursting in like a caged animal. "Where’s the money, Hayes? I know you’ve been hiding something in this dump!" he shouted, his voice hoarse and faltering, while his gold jewelry clinked against one another in an irritating metallic jingle.

"Oscar, I paid the $300 rent three weeks ago; there are still a few days left until the next rent is due," Lohan replied, keeping his voice calm as he felt Mana circulate through the inner pathways of his arms, warming his defined muscles.

"Don’t give me that bullshit, kid! The building’s purification fees have gone up, and I need a $350 advance NOW!" Oscar lunged forward, breathing heavily and foully.

Lohan instinctively activated his lung filter so he wouldn’t smell the stench of rot the man was exuding.

"And what kind of look is that on your ugly face?! You think you’re better than me just because you go to that trashy college?!" Oscar raised his fat hand, clenching his fist to deliver a clumsy blow to Lohan’s face.

However, to Lohan’s perception, honed by days of combat against predators with genuine hunting and killing experience, Oscar’s movement seemed to occur in slow motion.

Through the [Instinctive Perception] and [Viscous Flow] integrated into his physical body, he saw the punch’s trajectory even before Oscar’s arm was fully tensed.

If that punch hit him, his skin would instantly harden to disperse the impact, but Lohan had no intention of letting that happen.

"Lower your hand, Oscar..." Lohan said in a low, cold voice, exuding a faint trace of the newly developed murderous intent born from killing hundreds of monsters.

He didn’t move, but the intensity of the energy he now exuded made the landlord hesitate for a millisecond, panic flashing across his drug-clouded gaze.

Lohan actually had enough money to pay those $350, since of the $500 he’d withdrawn from Elysium last time, he still had $402 saved in his bank account.

The problem with this situation was that Oscar clearly wanted to take advantage of him, demanding $40 more than agreed, and being taken for a sucker wasn’t something Lohan liked.

But the fury induced by chemical stimulants and the desperation for another dose clouded what little remained of Oscar’s rationality.

With a scream that reeked of rot and cheap synthetic food, the landlord ignored the warning and lunged forward, throwing his full weight into a clumsy, straight punch.

To Lohan, it was like watching a Level 1 Goblin attempting a charge. Using the [Artificial Magic Core Harmonizer Lv 2], Lohan felt Mana flow instantly from his chest to his arm, warming his tendons just as it always did whenever he entered combat in Elysium.

He didn’t use [Non-Newtonian Resilience] to absorb the impact... he chose to go on the offensive. With a subtle pivot, Lohan slid to the side of Oscar’s fist’s trajectory and delivered a short, sharp punch directly to the man’s solar plexus.

The impact didn’t sound like flesh hitting flesh, but like a solid thud. Oscar froze in midair, his eyes bulging from their sockets as all the air in his lungs was expelled in an agonized hiss.

The fat man collapsed onto the apartment’s dirty floor, writhing like a worm, his fat hands clutching his stomach as he desperately tried to inhale any amount of air, which wouldn’t come.

Lohan watched the scene with a coldness that surprised him for a brief second; seeing that man on the floor, Lohan realized he felt the same indifference toward him as he did when he saw a Goblin being dissolved by his acid.

Without haste, he picked up his old cell phone with the cracked screen and opened the Atlas Bank app, where his balance of $402 glowed in the dim light of the apartment.

With a few taps, he completed the transfer.

"I just transferred $310 to your account, Oscar. The exact amount of rent you yourself stipulated last week," Lohan said, his voice sounding steady and dangerous as he crouched down near the fallen man. "I know you wanted $350, but I’m not your personal bank, much less a sucker you can extort to support your addiction."

Oscar was still trying to catch his breath, his face turning purple under the flickering light of the broken refrigerator.

"Consider this $310 an advance for next month. I’m staying in this apartment, and you’re going to stop banging on my door at all hours," Lohan continued, letting a trace of a predator’s murderous intent seep into his words. "If you try to come in here again without permission, or if you ’forget’ the agreed-upon amount one more time, I guarantee the next punch won’t just knock the wind out of you. You know how easy it is for someone to ’disappear’ in the Lower Zone, don’t you?"

Lohan stood up, feeling the Mana circulate back to the core of his chest, leaving a sensation of power and calm.

Oscar, finally managing to let out a shaky, wheezing breath, looked at Lohan with genuine terror, as if he were seeing one of the Upper Zone’s super-soldiers in disguise.

Without saying a word, the landlord shuffled out of the apartment, tripping over his own feet as he fled down the dark hallway.

Oscar couldn’t understand it, not only because of the drugs clouding his mind, but because it made no sense at all that the frail, skinny boy he bullied whenever he needed more money would suddenly possess such monstrous strength!

’Had he been hiding this strength all along?!’

Closing the door and locking it, Lohan sighed.

He now had only $92 left, a tight budget to get through the rest of the month, but the satisfaction of not having been made a fool of in the real world was incredible!

Adrenaline was coursing through his veins, making it hard for him to fall asleep, but Lohan didn’t care; he’d even decided to work out again to calm down.

But thinking that he needed another $820 to pay the bank interest, he pondered how to handle it.

Suddenly, he had an idea!

Chapter 144: 144 - Text Messages

His shoulders had broadened, creating a distinct "V" shape in his torso, and his posture, once hunched from malnutrition and the despair of the Lower Zone, now remained perfectly upright and firm.

His skin, which had once been pale, sickly, and dry, now displayed a soft, healthy glow, the result of [Efficient Digestion] that extracted every last nutrient from the Grade A solutions.

And to cap off this incredible sense of change, the factors he felt most were transforming and enhancing his body, even without a mirror to look at himself, were the two Cores he had within him.

Both the Magic Core and the Natural Energy Core were constantly generating energy inside him, filtering and purifying his body 100% of the time!

Lohan had to wait until he got to college to send the message to Lisa, since he didn’t feel confident enough to talk to her on the bus, especially since they’d be talking about money.

But as soon as he sat down in his usual spot in the classroom, he pulled his phone out of his pocket and started typing the message.

Here, the fear of being watched was almost nonexistent, considering that the people around him actively ignored any student from the Lower Zone like him.

After sending the message, Lohan intended to check the latest news from Elysium until Lisa replied, but surprisingly, she responded almost instantly!

Lohan raised an eyebrow, surprised by her honesty, and finding it cute that she was using emojis with him for the first time.

Lisa rarely gave details about her personal life, always maintaining a cold, professional facade even when they talked about trivial things. Hearing that explanation for why she was tired made Lohan raise his eyebrows slightly, and a subtle smile appeared at the corner of his mouth.

[Hayes: Ohh, I hope it was a pleasant conversation! I also had an... interesting early morning, so to speak. My crazy landlord decided to "break into" my apartment at one in the morning, completely high, demanding an advance on the rent. 🤦🏻]

[Hayes: No need, Lisa. He won’t be a bother for a while. Let’s just say the reflexes and strength I gained in Elysium served as "convincing arguments" for him to leave haha, but thanks for the offer. 😇🤣]

Suddenly the classroom door opened and everyone fell silent.

Standing there was Isabella Vance, drawing everyone’s attention, but surprisingly, unlike the cold, deadly expression she usually wore, she now had a small smile at the corner of her mouth as she looked at something on the floating golden hologram screen projected in front of her.

Seeing that expression on the face of the girl who normally showed no interest in anything was shocking, both to the students from the Upper Zone and those from the Lower Zone!

This caused their curiosity about what she was seeing on that screen to skyrocket.

Some thought she had received some good news from her family; others thought she might just be counting money, or watching a funny video, or, most shockingly, chatting with a boyfriend?!

That last possibility was what came to mind for most of the boys interested in Isabella and the girls who envied the heiress of the Vance Group.

Unfortunately, this doubt could only be resolved by asking her directly, since her hologram was in privacy mode, causing those around her to see only a blurry golden screen floating, unable to make out any of the content.

Isabella didn’t mind the attention she was getting, she was already used to this sort of thing, and walked calmly to the spot where she always sat, focusing on the screen.

Suddenly, Lohan’s phone vibrated, notifying him of a new message.

[Lisa: Convincing arguments?! Haha, knowing how you act, I think he’s lucky his brain wasn’t digested by you. 😂]

Lohan let out a soft laugh at her reply and quickly typed a response.

[Hayes: Lucky? I think that even if I could digest brains with my acid in this world, I still wouldn’t do it... I’m actually afraid of what I might find when I receive his memories... maybe the experience would be worse than the nightmare I went through when I digested the Level 11 Mana Stone!! 😳🫣]

"Pfft." Isabella Vance, on the other side of the room, chuckled upon seeing something on the holographic screen in front of her, making the people around her even more curious.

Every few seconds, whether it was Isabella on one side or Lohan on the other side of the room, they would laugh at something, but despite the coincidence, no one there realized just how much it seemed like they were laughing at the exact same thing!

But with his heightened senses, and knowing the exact moment the messages were sent and received, Lohan heard the girl’s soft laugh, which was made even more evident by the deathly silence around her, every time he sent a message to Lisa.

He even looked at her with a furrowed brow, but thinking of the "danger" of offending this Vance heiress, he looked away and went back to typing on his phone.

A few seconds later, upon hearing someone laugh right after she sent a message to Halon, Isabella also looked around and noticed a boy from the Lower Zone laughing at something he was seeing on the screen of his broken cell phone.

And surprisingly, that boy was the one who had argued with Julian Neal a few days ago!

’Could it be?’ Isabella wondered, shocked, yet hopeful, and also a little afraid, quickly looking away and not daring to face him.

And seeing someone take the opposite stance to all of that, knowing she had far more money than he did, someone who was truly in need of money, refusing her offer to pay more than the standard rate, and still wanting to receive only what was fair, was something entirely new to her.

Isabella stood still for a few seconds, just reading and rereading that message, unaware of a warm feeling that welled up in her chest as she did so.

’Could it be that he’s only acting this way because he doesn’t know how rich I am? Without realizing it, she was falling into the same guilt trip that self-serving people from the past had tried to instill in her mind, but now in a completely proactive way.

Sighing, she didn’t know what to do.

Chapter 147: 147 - The Promised Massage

Lisa, who had been on a high all day, had so much energy that she ran wildly through the area, focusing on everything around her to tire herself out physically and mentally.

Seeing that little blue Slime, with no facial expressions and no limbs to more easily show what it was thinking, the fox felt like smiling.

Analyzing the way the Slime spoke and acted toward her, Lisa found it more and more interesting how that little round, expressionless creature could display such a strong personality as well.

"You actually got here faster today, Halon..." she remarked curiously.

Lohan looked at her a little surprised and explained. "A little bit. I was lucky to catch a bus with a driver in a hurry today... he made some dangerous maneuvers, but in the end it was worth it to get home early. How are you? Have you been playing for a long time?"

Naturally, Lohan rolled over to Lisa and climbed onto her back, while his gelatinous body expanded and completely enveloped the fox’s body.

Lisa felt a refreshing sensation from his icy body enveloping hers, which was already hot from the physical exertion she’d been doing earlier.

"Not for very long, I just killed a few low-level monsters and managed to capture some Level 01 and Level 2 Dream Butterflies to sell to Intervar." She explained, making no comment about him hugging her body.

Although she was used to it, this time it felt a little different, making her cheeks hotter than usual.

She had always known he was the man controlling the character Halon, and even though their physical contact bothered her a little at first, over time she came to picture the Slime in her mind whenever she thought about this friend.

But now that she knew what his human face and body looked like, feeling him hugging her that way seemed to take on a different meaning.

’It’s strange going through this now that I know what his face looks like...’

Fortunately, perhaps because he didn’t seem like a disgusting person, didn’t cause her any revulsion, or because he was good-looking, Lisa didn’t feel as uncomfortable about it as she would have if someone else had done the same thing to her.

The problem was that as soon as he wrapped his arms around her body, Lisa felt a gentle, undulating sensation ripple through her, tensing and relaxing her muscles in a way so pleasantly unlike anything she’d ever felt before!

The sensation was so good that her mind went blank for a second, until she realized what was happening.

"HALON!" She shouted angrily, opening her mouth and firing a Spiritual Flame at the layer of blue gel that surrounded her.

Feeling the heat of that white flame, Lohan quickly tensed that part of his body and laughed through their mental link. "Hahaha, didn’t I tell you I’d give you a soothing massage when I found you here as a thank you?! I’m just paying my part of the deal!"

As he said this, Lohan intensified the massage, pressing her muscles in a way no human hand, or even a specialized machine, could manage.

Lisa had to force herself not to collapse to the floor in sheer bliss. "STOP IT, I DIDN’T SAY I WANTED YOUR MASSAGE!!!"

Luckily for her, her white fur perfectly hid the face that was now bright red with embarrassment, but her slightly trembling voice through the mental link, even if masked by "rage", caught Lohan’s attention, and if he had a face in that form, a mischievous expression would be plastered across it right now.

Chapter 148: 148 - Explosive Rabbits

It was hard to calm the enraged fox, but Lisa wasn’t unreasonable and let it slide as long as Lohan promised not to give any more massages without her consent.

"So if you agree, can I wrap you in a cozy hug and relax you with a soothing massage?" Lohan asked with a mischievous tone, holding back a laugh as he noticed the fox freeze for a moment.

"Shut up, Halon, or I’ll make you walk, or roll, all the way to our destination!" she said angrily, but in the end, she hadn’t denied what he’d said.

Just as this sensation was very new and interesting to Lisa, to Lohan it seemed even cooler.

As someone confined to a hospital bed in the other world, despite his high intelligence, his extreme physical limitations were a major obstacle to finding people to connect with.

Even friendships were hard to maintain, with everyone interacting with him only out of interest in getting close to his family, or acting out of pity after discovering how frail he was.

If having ordinary friendships was already difficult, the closest he could get to a romantic relationship was when he watched movies, TV shows, anime, or read novels.

He always dreamed of living out his youth the way he saw in the movies, going to parties, meeting girls, kissing someone on the mouth, but that was never possible.

Who would have thought that his first romantic interaction would be with a fox in a virtual world?!

’Even though I can treat this as if I were on VRChat, she only has an animal avatar; it’s not even like she chose to be a furry.’ He thought, finding the situation amusing.

And even though he didn’t know what Lisa looked like in the real world, that didn’t bother Lohan in the slightest.

Given how pleasant her company was when they were together, Lisa could be a girl who completely defied aesthetic standards, whether in terms of weight or physical issues like the ones he’d once had, and he wouldn’t care one bit about it.

After all, how hypocritical would it be to become exactly the kind of person he’d always hated?

Even though his appearance was improving every day, it wasn’t something that went to his head, as if he had some standard that he’d only date women more beautiful than him, or something like that.

Appearance might even be important for creating that initial connection, but for them, who were already connecting emotionally in such a subtle and pleasant way, Lohan didn’t think he’d care if one day he met Lisa and discovered she weighed twice as much as he did.

Sure, that might surprise him a little, but with all the Evolutions he was getting, couldn’t he someday get something to help her lose weight? Or make her more beautiful?

And even if he couldn’t, Lohan didn’t have high standards; just having good company by his side would already be incredible for him.

What he didn’t know was that even if he raised his expectations several times over, Isabella would still manage to meet them all!

"We’re here. I think this is where we can find their burrows," Lisa said as she slowed down and looked around alertly.

Lohan also stopped daydreaming and focused on his tracking skills, searching for any living creature.

The section of the Mythlorien Forest where they found themselves seemed, at first glance, an idyllic habitat for leporids, filled with dense clover and low-lying berry bushes.

However, Lohan noticed small craters of scorched earth scattered across the ground, as if micro-explosions had occurred there recently, a clear sign of the Explosive Rabbits’ presence.

Lohan wasted no time and activated his qualitative tracking stack, using [Instinctive Perception Lv 15] in conjunction with [Spatial Echo-Location]. He utilized the [Parallel Processing Core] to filter out wind noise and focus exclusively on the vibrations traveling through the subsoil.

For eight minutes of absolute concentration, the Slime remained motionless above Lisa, mapping the environment in 360 degrees.

Suddenly, a violent, rhythmic frequency hit Lohan’s sensors. "Lisa, to our left! I’m sensing three thermal signatures moving at high speed!"

Shadows with metallic-gray fur burst through the vegetation, followed by sonic booms.

It was the Explosive Rabbits! Lohan watched, amazed and impressed by the anatomy of these creatures.

Their hind legs were disproportionately muscular and saturated with Mana. As they moved, the rabbits pounded their feet on the ground in a rhythmic and frantic manner, with the accumulated impact generating a small pressure blast that propelled them forward in a blur of terrifying speed.

’Is that... literally the Soru movement from the Pirate Navy?!’, Lohan thought, shocked yet amused, recalling the locomotion techniques he’d seen in the other world. ’They use their hind legs like combustion pistons to achieve that speed.’

The monsters showed no fear.

Unlike ordinary rabbits that eat only plants, these Explosive Rabbits were entirely carnivorous, and upon spotting the duo, the rabbits changed their trajectory at sharp angles, striking the ground simultaneously to execute a very well-coordinated charge.

"Lisa, I’m going into Living Armor mode! I’ll need [Non-Newtonian Resilience] to disperse the shock from those kicks!" Lohan said via mental link, expanding his blue biomass and covering the fox’s flanks with the [Obsidian Exoskeleton Lv 7] at the same time.

Lisa growled, her paws already emitting the white glow of [Spiritual Fire] as she prepared to intercept the first gray blur flying toward her.

Seeing the speed these rabbits displayed, Lohan felt a bit of envy and anticipation, wondering if he could absorb this evolution of these creatures!

The first gray blur struck Lisa’s side with a sound that wasn’t that of a direct, sharp thud, but rather the sound of a muffled explosion.

Lohan felt [Non-Newtonian Resilience] activate instantly, hardening his membrane at the point of impact to disperse the kinetic energy. However, to his horror, the force of the kick was so massive that the pressure wasn’t completely nullified... it traveled through his gelatinous mass like a subsonic shockwave, striking the slender body of the fox beneath him.

Chapter 149: 149 - They are The Speed?

Lisa let out a sharp yelp through the mental link, losing her balance for a millisecond after the heavy blow she had taken. "Halon! My ribs... the impact went right through you!"

Lohan was shocked. His defense, which until then had seemed invulnerable against physical impacts of a similar level, had reached its qualitative limit.

He quickly activated [Microscopic Focus] and [Instinctive Perception Lv 15] to analyze the attackers circling the pair at high speed, leaving trails of scorched earth behind them.

Upon carefully analyzing the targets, Lohan realized that among the group of five rabbits, three were slightly slower and weaker, while the other two were slightly more powerful.

And based on the force of the impact he received from one of the slower rabbits, he deduced that this group consisted of three Level 9 Rabbits and two Level 10 Rabbits.

As monsters focused on a single attribute, the explosive force of their paws, these creatures’ kicks possessed a kinetic piercing power that partially ignored his defenses. If they fought at their own pace, Lisa would be riddled with internal fractures in a matter of minutes.

"They’re too fast for a head-on confrontation, Lisa! If we try to chase them, we’ll be kicked to death before we tire them out." Lohan transmitted, feeling the [Parallel Processing Core] working at full speed to formulate a strategy. "We need to take the ground out from under them. Literally."

Taking advantage of the fact that he was still in symbiosis as Living Armor, Lohan expanded part of his biomass into the ground beneath Lisa’s paws. He didn’t use the exoskeleton this time; instead, he activated [Selective Viscosity] in its most extreme form of Adhesion.

At the same time, he used [Magic Weaving Lv 3] to shoot nearly invisible blue filaments toward the trunks of the surrounding trees, creating a low-hanging web, just thirty centimeters off the ground.

"Lisa, use [Spectral Step] to lure them to the center of this quadrant!" Lohan commanded.

Lisa understood the plan!

Ignoring the internal pain, she shot off like a white blur, but the two Level 10 rabbits, sensing the movement, slammed their paws on the ground simultaneously, launching themselves in a charge that distorted the air.

The moment the first Level 10 rabbit struck the [Magic Weaving Lv 3] net, it didn’t stop. In a purely instinctive reflex, the monster unleashed an explosive kick against the mana-infused threads themselves. The small detonation generated by its hind leg created a shockwave that, while it didn’t sever the mana-infused threads, loosened the trap’s tension enough for it to use the recoil and launch itself backward, escaping the initial entanglement.

Meanwhile, the second Level 10 rabbit, sensing the danger on the ground, changed course mid-air. Using the explosive force of its paws to kick off a nearby tree trunk, it executed a maneuver that defied inertia, leaping over the webbed area and landing in a blind spot behind Lisa.

"Halon, to the right! He jumped over the net!" Lisa transmitted urgently, but the pain in her ribs [from previous interactions] made her hesitate for a split second, preventing an immediate new [Spectral Step].

Lohan didn’t need Lisa’s warning; with his 360-degree vision, he saw perfectly the movement the rabbit made and the approach of its attack once again.

The rabbit hit the ground with a thud, and before Lisa could even turn completely, it delivered a side kick. Lohan reacted instantly, activating [Non-Newtonian Resilience] and the [Obsidian Exoskeleton Lv 7] on Lisa’s right flank.

-- BOOM! --

The impact was tremendous.

Although Lohan’s membrane had hardened like steel at the point of contact, the "explosive" nature of the blow transformed the kinetic energy into a high-frequency vibration that pierced through the armor once more.

Lisa was hurled sideways, her feet losing traction on the ground as she screamed in pain through the mental link.

The three Level 9 rabbits, seeing their advantage, began circling the pair at high speed, pounding their paws on the ground to maintain their high velocity.

To Lohan’s senses, the thermal signatures picked up by [Thermal Perception Lv 9] were blurred, frantic shapes surrounding his 360-degree field of view.

"Damn, they’re using the trees to avoid the ground!" Lohan analyzed, realizing that the creatures’ numerical advantage and aerial agility were overwhelming their defensive strategy.

Even though these rabbits were low-rarity creatures, far inferior to a Legendary Fox and a Mythic Slime, fighting these monsters on their home turf, while at a numerical and level disadvantage, was greatly diminishing their advantage!

Through the [Parallel Processing Core], Lohan attempted to coordinate two tiny clones to grab the Level 9 rabbits’ paws, but their speed was so great and the force of their kicks so powerful that the gelatinous masses were simply "run over" before they could apply [Selective Viscosity].

For the first time since entering the deep forest, the duo felt they were struggling not to be overwhelmed by sheer speed.

The rabbits maintained the initiative, attacking in coordinated bursts that didn’t allow Lisa to catch her breath enough for an effective [Spiritual Fire] counterattack, while Lohan’s mind raced at top speed to devise a plan for dealing with these rabbits without getting caught up in their speed game.

"Lisa, stop chasing them. Let’s change the frequency of this fight. I’m going to saturate your system with Natural Energy!" Lohan commanded via mental link.

Through the symbiosis as Living Armor, Lohan activated the [Natural Energy Core Lv 2], forcing energy pathways to open through his biomass to channel the raw essence of this energy directly into Lisa’s circulatory system.

He utilized the [Weaver Mother Lv 2] to act as a bidirectional conduit, injecting Mana as well, in addition to the massive charge of refined vitality.

Lisa felt an overwhelming heat course through her muscles. Her white flames of the [Spiritual Fire] took on a slightly greenish, stable hue, and the pain from the microfractures caused by the previous impacts receded under the flow of Lohan’s [Bio-Synthetic Mana Circulation].

With that newfound strength within her, Lisa’s confidence returned.

Chapter 150: 150 - Trap

To deal with the rabbits that used the trees to avoid the ground, Lohan decided to use the creatures’ simple minds against them.

Using the [Parallel Processing Core], he orchestrated a sensory illusion maneuver. He summoned three clones via [Partial Division] and used [Pigmentation Mimicry] so that each would take on a form and thermal signature similar to Lisa’s, while the fox’s real body was shrouded in [Umbral Mimicry], making it nearly invisible in the shadows cast by the tree trunks.

Fortunately, he had practiced making fox legs extensively the day before; otherwise, this plan would have been impossible, even if he had made the Slime clones turn white like Lisa.

The rabbits, driven by basic predatory instincts, saw four identical targets and split up. The moment one of the Level 10 rabbits leaped from an oak tree to strike what they thought was the fox, Lohan played his trump card, a [Magic Weaving Lv 2] concentrated to the maximum with Natural Energy!

This was already a Skill that consumed a large amount of Mana; using Natural Energy to fuel it even further was extremely draining for him, but Lohan gritted his teeth and used that energy anyway.

Infusing the threads with Natural Energy, Lohan created an invisible web of filaments between the nearby trees. When the rabbits launched their charge, they didn’t hit their prey, but instead struck an extremely resilient and adhesive Mana web that glowed neon blue upon contact.

Lohan’s [Non-Newtonian Resilience], now integrated into the web, caused the fibers to harden instantly in response to the explosive impact of the monsters’ paws, harnessing the superior power of Natural Energy to absorb all kinetic energy and immobilize them in midair.

"Now, Lisa!" Lohan vibrated.

With the overflowing vitality provided by Lohan, Lisa didn’t fire normal fireballs. She let out a spiritual roar and expanded her [Spiritual Fire] into a circular wave. The flames devoured the rabbits trapped in the web and weakly struck the Level 9 ones in the distance, who were confused by the clones.

[Experience: +190]

The second Level 10 rabbit, which had leaped over the initial net, retreated upon seeing its partner reduced to ashes by the wave of greenish-white flames.

His bloodshot eyes glowed with fury as he pounded his hind legs rapidly against the ground, preparing a full-power charge to break through the encirclement and avenge his partner.

Lohan felt a pang of mental exhaustion pierce his core.

Using [Natural Energy] to overload [Magic Weaving Lv 2] had drained his stamina at an alarming rate, causing his blue gelatin to pulsate irregularly. However, through [Bio-Synthetic Mana Circulation], he began absorbing the smoking remains of the first rabbit, refining the charred biomass into rapid pulses of Mana to sustain the reservoir.

Not knowing if Lisa could see what the rabbit was doing, Lohan explained. "Lisa, the Level 10 survivor is preparing a head-on charge! It’s going to try to blow up the web with a concentrated kick, get ready!" Lohan warned as he focused his [Instinctive Perception Lv 15] to map the trajectory of the kinetic pressure.

The monster charged.

With a near-deafening explosion, the rabbit struck the threads imbued with natural energy with both hind legs simultaneously.

Lohan reacted in the millisecond of contact, activating [Non-Newtonian Resilience] throughout the entire web; the fibers, glowing neon blue, instantly hardened like high-strength steel beams, absorbing the explosive shock that would have shattered any ordinary defense.

The rabbit’s small brain didn’t understand why his companion had been trapped, and he thought that, due to the confidence from his previous dominance in battle, he believed he only needed to use his most powerful attack to break through those threads.

But instead of breaking free from the trap, the rabbit found his paws stuck in the threads’ extreme [Selective Viscosity], just like his companion.

"Now, for the finishing move, pierce him with your flames!" Lohan commanded, activating the [Parallel Processing Core] to coordinate the remaining Mana.

Lisa, driven by the vitality still coursing through her veins, leaped in a perfect arc. Channeling the [Spiritual Fire] into the tips of her front claws, she created a blade of reddish-white plasma. While still in the air, Lohan materialized a [Ice Spike] smaller than usual but extremely dense, which merged with her attack.

The blow struck the trapped monster’s skull. The collision between the compressed ice core and the concentrated flames caused a micro-cranial implosion in the rabbit, silencing the Level 10 beast instantly.

[Experience: +210]

The three remaining Level 9 rabbits, seeing their leaders eliminated, tried to flee by using the trees as desperate jumping platforms.

However, Lohan’s clones, which had previously served only as decoys, clung to the rabbits while alternating their viscosity between super-sticky and zero-adhesion, causing the creatures to lose their balance and traction and crash into the surrounding tree trunks, making the situation even more chaotic.

Mercilessly, Lisa cleared the battlefield with short bursts of flame, while Lohan gathered the bodies into their reservoir, removing only small parts of the corpses to eat, feeling the Biomass replenish his losses.

[Experience: +163]

[Experience: +137]

[Experience: +151]

The experience gained in this battle raised his total experience from 1,230 → 1,982 / 25,600.

He still had a long way to go before reaching level 10, but considering how quick this hunt was, he didn’t worry too much.

Fortunately, these rabbits’ bodies were quite small, so since they were high-level, their biomass density was very high for every kilogram of meat Lohan digested.

Not even the charred carcass was spared.

Keeping only the rabbits’ tendons and ligaments, the valuable parts Intervar had asked them to hunt for, Lohan digested everything, starting with each one’s brain, hoping to gain a useful evolution from these creatures.

The first rabbit didn’t yield any new evolutions...

[Viscous Flow Lv 24 → Lv 25] - 2.09 m/s → 2.29 m/s

The second rabbit didn’t either...

[Membrane Reinforcement Lv 28 → Lv 29]

Finally, with the third rabbit, Lohan received the message he had been waiting for.

[New Matter Digested...]

Chapter 151: 151 - Slime Explosion

As soon as he digested the third rabbit’s brain, the message he loved to read so much appeared before him.

[New Digested Matter - Explosive Steps]

[Evolution available]

Without hesitation, Lohan accepted this new evolution.

[Explosive Steps Lv 1] - 25 Bio

[By channeling Mana through the ligaments and tendons of the leg, it accumulates great kinetic force which, when released, results in a powerful explosion at the point of impact.]

The description of this evolution was quite simple; surprisingly, the ability to kick the same spot multiple times in a fraction of a second to move at high speed had been developed by the rabbits themselves.

’It’s crazy how these animals, even without a truly intelligent consciousness, can come up with such profound uses for an evolution like this!’ He thought. ’But it does make sense, after all; if they didn’t know how to use this evolution in such an innovative way, maybe they wouldn’t even reach Level 10...’

In such an aggressive and oppressive environment, the act of surviving to Level 10 was already commendable, especially with such low intelligence and without a System like the Players had.

"Wait a moment, Lisa, I want to test my new skill," Lohan said as he shifted back into the fox’s body and leaped to the ground.

Lisa also stopped running and looked at him expectantly.

She envied his ability to absorb skills from other creatures, but she didn’t dislike it either, since it was because of his versatility that they were able to face monsters that a group of 10 Players at their level would have difficulty facing.

So over time she started treating it like a game; whenever Halon acquired a new skill from a monster, she enjoyed watching him try it out and seeing if he was lucky enough to get a useful skill or not.

Often he would acquire that monster’s main skill, but most of the time he wouldn’t get anything new, or if he did, it was just something completely useless to them.

Now she wanted to know if this would be one of those times or not.

To her surprise, as soon as Halon landed on the ground, instead of rolling as he always did, he quickly formed four paws beneath him and assumed a stance very similar to that of the Level 10 rabbit’s last powerful charge.

That alone made the fox’s eyes sparkle.

If Halon was adopting this stance, it was quite possible that he had acquired the same skill as the rabbits!

With Mana flowing through the leg he had formed, Lohan felt kinetic energy accumulating there, and with a mental smile, he finally kicked the ground, preparing for the speed he would gain from it!

But instead of the explosive sound the kick would make, as the rabbits did, the sound Lohan made was that of jelly shattering, followed by a stinging pain.

--SPLASH!

Horrified, Lohan saw clearly that as soon as the Mana and kinetic energy spread out from his "leg," the power of that energy was so great that not even the Obsidian Exoskeleton could withstand it and shattered all around, flinging slime jelly everywhere.

Fortunately, the Slimes’ pain receptors were far less sensitive than a human’s; otherwise, with an explosion of a limb like that, Lohan might even have fainted.

But with his current body, he only felt the pain as if a cut were being made, and with the rapid digestion of the rabbit leg that had appeared inside him, it quickly replenished the biomass and alleviated the pain.

"Um... I don’t think that was the intended use of your skill, right?" Lisa asked in a muffled voice, finding the situation extremely cute and comical, the slime’s leg exploding and him standing completely still for a few seconds, staring at it, lost in thought.

Sure, if what had exploded instead of the shiny blue jelly had actually been real flesh and blood, the scene would have been much more grotesque and not at all scary.

But since what exploded was just the blue jelly, Lisa had to muster a lot of willpower to keep her composure and not burst out laughing right there.

Lohan looked at his companion and rolled his eyes mentally, but he also found the situation funny.

"Yeah... theoretically, this skill was supposed to let me kick and cause explosions like the rabbits did, but apparently, since I don’t have tendons or ligaments, the resulting force spreads throughout my body instead of flowing outward, blowing me up..." Lohan explained what he understood about the glitch that had occurred.

That was very disappointing... especially since he couldn’t think of how to deal with it for now, turning a skill with so much potential into something completely useless to him for the time being.

And thinking about how this skill worked, if he could create artificial tendons and ligaments inside himself, he could get rid of the limitation of using it only for kicks, and also use punches or other types of attacks with this skill!

After all, rabbits only had leg muscles developed enough to perform those kicks, but Lohan could simulate any part of his body as ’legs’ and use this skill however he wanted!

But while he was thinking about what to do, Lisa interrupted with an idea.

"Don’t you already have the most powerful ligaments we know of?" she asked with a sparkle in her eyes.

Lohan was confused by the question, so he strained to understand it, until it clicked.

"Lisa, if this works, you’re a genius!" Lohan said excitedly as he began to produce thick, sturdy webs within himself, simulating the tendons and ligaments he should have in his leg joints.

Assuming the preparation stance once more, Lohan channeled his Mana through his magical webs and felt that his control over it was far more refined and manageable.

Taking a deep breath, he braced himself for the pain a failure might bring, but fortunately, this time the sound was different!

--BOOOM!

Following the explosion, a bright blue figure flew past Lisa at high speed and continued moving forward at high speed toward a tree.

Lohan’s speed was still far below that of the rabbits, but considering that this Skill was still at Level 01, he was excited to invest a little more in it.
